a: Rabbi yonatan omer: mizze bifne atzmo, umizze bifne atzmo. amar lo rabbi yoshiyya: vahalo kevar neemar: "achat"!
Amar lo rabbi yonatan, vahalo kevar neemar: "middam happar umiddam hassair"! im ken, lamma neemar "achat"? lomar lach: achat velo shetayim middam happar, achat velo shetayim middam hassair.

Tanya iddach: "velakach middam happar umiddam hassair" — sheyyihyu meoravin ze baze. atta omer sheyyihyu meoravin ze baze, o eno ella mizze bifne atzmo umizze bifne atzmo? talmud lomar: "achat". usetama kerabbi yoshiyya.
Natan et hammale barekan vechulei. bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: hinniach mizrak betoch mizrak, vekibbel bo et haddam, mahu? min bemino chotzetz, o eno chotzetz?
Amar leh, tenetuha: natan et hammale barekan. may lav: hoshiv mizrak male letoch mizrak rekan?
La, era mizrak male letoch mizrak rekan. ha tena leh resha: era dam happar letoch dam hassair! kede learvan yafe yafe.
Ta shema: haya omed al gabbe keli, o al gabbe regel chavero — pasul! shane regel, dela matze mevattel leh.

Ikka deamri, hachi bea minneh: derech sherut bechach, o en derech sherut bechach? ta shema, detana deve rabbi yishmael: "et kol kele hashsharet asher yeshartu vam bakkodesh" — shene chelim vesherut achat.
Bea minneh rame bar chama merav chisda: hinniach siv betoch hammizrak, vekibbel bo et haddam, mahu: min besheeno mino chotzetz, o eno chotzetz? kevan dimchalchel — la chayetz, o dilma la shena?
Amar leh, tenena: zolef veholech ad shemmaggia lassefog! shane mayya diklishi.
Ikka deamri, hachi peshat leh: bedam — kasher. bekometz — pasul.
b: Mishna "veyatza el hammizbeach asher lifne Adonai", ze mizbach hazzahav. hitchil mechatte veyored, mehechan hu matchil? mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit, deromit mizrachit. makom shehu matchil bachattat al mizbeach hachitzon — mishsham haya gomer al mizbeach happenimi.
Rabbi eliezer omer: bimkomo haya omed umechatte.

Veal kullan haya noten millematta lemala, chutz mizzo shehayta lefanav, shehaya noten millemala lematta. hizza al tohoro shel mizbeach sheva peamim, usheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon, veshel mizbeach hachitzon haya shofech el yesod deromi. ellu veellu mitarvin baamma veyotzin lenachal kidron, venimkarin laggannanin lezabbel, umoalin bahen.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "veyatza el hammizbeach", ma talmud lomar? amar rabbi nechemya: lefi shemmatzinu befar habba al kol hammitzvot, shekkohen omed chutz lammizbeach umazze al happarochet beshaa shehu mazze, yachol af ze ken,
Talmud lomar: "veyatza el hammizbeach". hechan haya — lifnim min hammizbeach.

Tanya iddach: "lifne Adonai", ma talmud lomar? amar rabbi nechemya: lefi shemmatzinu befar vesair shel yom hakkippurim shekkohen omed lifnim min hammizbeach umazze al happarochet beshaa shehu mazze, yachol af ze, ken,
Talmud lomar: "mizbach ketoret hassammim lifne Adonai asher beohel moed" — mizbeach lifne Adonai, veen kohen lifne Adonai. ha ketzad? omed chutz lammizbeach umazze.

Hitchil mechatte veyored vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hitchil mechatte veyored. mehechan haya matchil? mikkeren mizrachit deromit, deromit maaravit, maaravit tzefonit, tzefonit mizrachit, divre rabbi akiva. rabbi yose haggelili omer: mikkeren mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit, deromit mizrachit.
Makom sherabbi yose haggelili matchil, sham rabbi akiva posek. makom sherabbi akiva matchil, sham rabbi yose haggelili posek.
Dechulle alma miha, behahu keren defaga beresha — la aved. may tama? amar shemuel, deamar kera: "veyatza el hammizbeach", ad denafek mikkulleh mizbeach.
Ulerabbi akiva, nakkef derech yamin? lema bidrame bar yechezkel ka mippalgi,

Deamar rame bar yechezkel: yam sheasa shelomo — "omed al shenem asar bakar shelosha fonim tzafona ushelosha fonim yamma ushelosha ponim negba ushelosha ponim mizracha vehayyam alehem milmala vechol achorehem bayta". ha lamadta, shekkol pinnot sheatta pone lo yehu ella derech yamin, lammizrach. mar it leh derame bar yechezkel, umar let leh derame bar yechezkel.
La, dechulle alma it lehu derame bar yechezkel. vehacha beha ka mippalgi, mar savar: yalfinan penim michutz, umar savar: la yalfinan penim michutz.

Verabbi akiva nehi dela yalef penim michutz, i bae — hachi naaved, i bae — hachi naaved? amar lach rabbi akiva: middina behahu keren defaga beresha — behahu aved beresha, deamar resh lakish: en maavirin al hammitzvot.
Veammay la aved — mishshum dichtiv: "veyatza el hammizbeach", ad denafek mikkulleh mizbeach. vechevan deyahev behahu keren — hadar ate lehahu keren deichayyayv lemittav beresha.

a: Vei baet ema: i sevira lan hakkafa baregel — dechulle alma la peligi deyalfinan penim michutz. vehacha beha ka mippalgi: mar savar hakkafa bayyad, umar savar hakkafa baregel.
Vei baet ema: dechulle alma hakkafa bayyad, vehacha beha ka mippalgi: mar savar yalfinan yad meregel, umar savar: la yalfinan.

Vesavar rabbi yose haggelili hakkafa bayyad? veha middekatane sefa: rabbi eliezer omer: bimkomo haya omed umechatte, mikkelal detanna kamma la sevira leh. ella mechavvavrta chidshanninan meikkara: mar savar hakkafa bayyad, umar savar hakkafa baregel.
Vei baet ema, beha ka mippalgi: mar savar: saviv demizbeach penimi kesaviv demizbeach hachitzon, umar savar: kulleh mizbeach penimi bimkom chada keren demizbeach chitzon kae.
Tanya, amar rabbi yishmael: shene chohanim gedolim nishtayyeyru bemikdash rishon, ze omer: beyadi hikkafti, veze omer: beraglay hikkafti. ze noten taam lidvarav, veze noten taam lidvarav.
Ze noten taam lidvarav: saviv demizbeach penimi kesaviv demizbeach hachitzon, veze noten taam lidvarav: kulleh mizbeach penimi bimkom chada keren dechitzon kae.

Rabbi eliezer omer: bimkomo haya omed umechatte. matnitin manni — rabbi yehuda hi. detanya, rabbi meir omer: rabbi eliezer omer: bimkomo omed umechatte, veal kullan haya noten mimmala lematta, chutz meotah shebbaalachson, shennoten mimmatta lemala.

Rabbi yehuda omer: rabbi eliezer omer: bimkomo omed umechatte, veal kullan hu noten millematta lemala, chutz mizzo shehayta lefanav mammash, shennoten mimmala lematta, ki hechi dela nittavvevsan maneh.
Hizza mimmennu al tohoro shel mizbeach. may "tohoro"? amar rabba bar rav shela: palgeh demizbeach, kidamri inashe: "tehar tihara vehave palgeh deyoma".

Metivi: keshehu mazze — eno mazze lo al gabbe haefer velo al gabbe haggechalim, ella chote gechalim elach veelach, umazze. ella amar rabba bar rav shela: al gilluye demizbeach, kedichtiv: "ucheetzem hashshamayim latohar".
Tanya, chananya omer: betzad tzefoni hu noten, rabbi yose omer: betzad deromi hu noten. bemay kamippalgi? mar savar: pitcha bedarom kae, umar savar: pitcha betzafon kae.
Dechulle alma miha, hecha degamran mattanot dikranot, hatam yahev al gaggo. may tama? amar kera: "vetiharo vekiddesho" — makom shekkiddesho, sham tiharo.
Sheyare haddam haya shofech al yesod maaravi shel mizbeach hachitzon. deamar kera: "veet kol dam happar yishpoch", vechi nafek — behahu paga beresha.
Veshel mizbeach hachitzon haya shofech al yesod deromit. tanu rabbanan: yesod hammizbeach — ze yesod deromit. atta omer yesod deromit, o eno ella yesod maaravit?
Amarta: yilmad yeridato min hakkevesh litziato min hahechol. ma yetziato min hahechol besamuch lo, vee ze — ze yesod maaravi, af yeridato min hakkevesh, besamuch lo, vee ze — ze yesod deromi.
Tanya, rabbi yishmael omer: ze vaze yesod maaravi. rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: ze vaze yesod deromi. bishlama, rabbi yishmael kasavar: yilmad satum mimmeforash.
Ella, rabbi shimon ben yochay, may tama? amar rav ashe: kasavar pitcha bedarom kae.
Tana deve rabbi yishmael bidve rabbi shimon ben yochay: ze vaze yesod deromit. vesimanaych: mashchu gavre legavra.
Ellu vaellu mitarvin baamma veyotzin vechulei. tanu rabbanan: moalin bedamim — divre rabbi meir verabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim: en moalin bahen.
b: Ad kan la peligi ella midderabbanan, aval middeorayyta en moalin bahen.
Mena hane mille? amar ulla, amar kera: "lachem" — shellachem yehe. deve rabbi shimon tana: "lechapper" — lechappara netattiv, velo limila.
Verabbi yochanan amar, amar kera: "hu", lifne chappara kilachar kappara: ma leachar kappara en bo meila — af lifne kappara en bo meila.
Veema, leachar kappara kelifne chappara: ma lifne chappara yesh bo meila — af leachar kappara yesh bo meila! en lecha davar shennaaset mitzvato umoalin bo. vela? vahare terumat haddeshen!

a: Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen uvigde chehunna shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad — en melammedin.
Hanicha lerabbanan, deamri: "vehinnicham sham", melammed shetteunin geniza.
Ella lerabbi dosa, deamar: bigde chehunna reuyin hen lechohen hedyot, may ikka lememar?
Mishshum dehave terumat haddeshen veegla arufa shene chetuvin habbain keechad, vechol shene chetuvin habbain keechad — en melammedin.
Hanicha leman deamar en melammedin, ella leman deamar melammedin, may ikka lememar? tere miute ketivi: "vesamo", "haarufa".
Vehane telata kerae bedam — lema li?
Chad lemaote minnotar, vechad lemaote mimmeila, vechad lemaote mittumea.
Aval mippiggul la tzerich lemaote kera, ditnan: kol sheyyesh lo mattirin, ben leadam, ben lemizbeach — chayyayvin alav mishshum piggul. vedam atzmo mattir hu.

Mishna kol maase yom hakkippurim haamur — al hasseder. im hikdim maase lachavero — lo asa kelum. hikdim dam hassair ledam happar — yachzor veyazze middam hassair leachar dam happar. veim ad shello gamar et hammattanot shebbifnim nishpach haddam — yavi dam acher, veyachzor battechilla mibbifnim.
Vechen bahechol, vechen bemizbach hazzahav — shekkullan kappara bifne atzman. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak, mishsham hu matchil.

Gemara tanu: rabbanan kol maase yom hakkippurim haamur — al hasseder. im hikdim maase lachavero — lo asa kelum. amar rabbi yehuda: ematay? bidvarim hannaasin bevigde lavan mibbifnim, aval devarim hannaasin bevigde lavan mibbachutz, im hikdim maase lachavero — ma sheasa asuy.

Rabbi nechemya omer: bamme devarim amurim — bidvarim hannaasim bevigde lavan, ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz. aval bidvarim hannaasim bevigde zahav mibbachutz — ma sheasa asuy. amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "vehayta zot lachem lechukkat olam achat bashshana",
b: Rabbi yehuda savar: makom shemmitkapperin bo paam achat bashshana. verabbi nechemya savar: devarim hammitkapperin bahen paam achat bashshana.
Attu lerabbi yehuda "makom" ketiv? ella, hayeynu tameh derabbi yehuda: ketiv "zot", uchetiv "achat". chad lemaote bigde lavan mibbachutz, vechad lemaote bigde zahav.
Verabbi nechemya: chad lemaote bigde zahav, vechad lemaote shirayim dela meakkevi. verabbi yehuda: i meakkevi — meakkevi, vei la meakkevi — la meakkevi.

Kidtanya: "vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh", im kipper — killa, veim lo kipper — lo killa, divre rabbi akiva. amar lo rabbi yehuda: mippene ma lo neemar: im killa — kipper, veim lo killa — lo kipper, sheim chisser achat min hammattanot lo asa velo chelum.
Veamrinan: may benayyhu? rabbi yochanan verabbi yehoshua ben levi. chad amar: mashmaut dorshin ikka benayyhu. vechad amar: shirayim meakkevi ikka benayyhu.
Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: tanna rabbi nechemya kedivre haomer shirayim meakkevi! kashya.

Amar rabbi chanina: ketoret shechafanah kodem shechitato shel par — la asa velo chelum. keman — dela kerabbi yehuda, dei rabbi yehuda, haamar: ki ketiva "chukka" — bidvarim hannaasim bevigde lavan mibbifnim hu dichtiva!

Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, tzorech penim — kifnim dame. tenan: im ad shello gamar mattanot shebbifnim nishpach haddam — yavi dam acher, veyachazor veyazze battechilla mibbifnim. veim ita, yachzor veyachpon mibbee leh!

a: Biktoret la ka mayyre.

Amar ulla: sair sheshshechato kodem mattan damo shel par — lo asa velo chelum. tenan: hikdim dam hassair ledam happar — yachzor veyazze middam hassair achar dam happar. veim ita — yachzor veyishchot mibbee leh! targema ulla, bemattanot shebbahechol. vechen amar rabbi appas, bemattanot shebbahechol.
Vechen bahechol vechen bammizbeach vechulei. tanu rabbanan: "vechipper et mikdash hakkodesh" — ze lifnay velifnim, "ohel moed" — ze hechol, "mizbeach" — kemashmao, "yechapper" — ellu azarot.

"Hakkohanim" — kemashmaan, "am hakkahal" — ellu yisrael, "yechapper" — ellu haleviyyim. hushevu kullan lechappara achat, shekkullan mitkapperin besair hammishtalleach bishar averot, divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi shimon omer: keshem sheddam hassair hannaase bifnim mechapper al yisrael betumeat mikdash vekadashav — kach dam happar mechapper al hakkohanim betumeat mikdash vekadashav. ucheshem shevvidduy shel sair hammishtalleach mechapper al yisrael bishar averot — kach vidduy shel par mechapper al hakkohanim bishar averot.
Tanu rabbanan: "vechilla mikkapper et hakkodesh" — ze lifnay velifnim, "ohel moed" — ze hechol, "mizbeach" — kemashmao, melammed shekkullan kappara kappara bifne atzman.

Mikkan amru: natan miktzat mattanot shebbifnim venishpach haddam — yavi dam acher veyatchil battechilla bemattanot shebbifnim. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: eno matchil ella mimmakom sheppasak. gamar et hammattanot shebbifnim venishpach haddam — yavi dam acher veyatchil battechilla bemattanot shebbahechol.
Natan miktzat mattanot shebbahechol venishpach haddam — yavi dam acher veyatchil battechilla bahechol. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: eno matchil ella mimmakom sheppasak.

Gamar mattanot shebbahechol venishpach haddam — yavi dam acher veyatchil battechilla bemattenot hammizbeach. natan miktzat mattanot shebbammizbeach venishpach haddam — yavi dam acher veyatchil battechilla bemattenot hammizbeach. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil. gamar mattanot shebbammizbeach venishpach haddam — divre hakkol la meakkevi.
Amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "middam chattat hakkippurim achat bashshana",
Rabbi meir savar: chattat achat amarti lach, velo shete chattaot. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri: chittuy echad amarti lach, velo shene chittuyin.
Tanya, amar rabbi: li chillek rabbi yaakov balluggin.
Velo? vehatanya: natan miktzat mattanot shebbifnim venishpach hallog — yavi log acher veyatchil battechilla bemattanot shebbahechol. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil.

Gamar mattanot shebbahechol venishpach hallog — yavi log acher veyatchil battechilla bemattanot shebbabbehonot. natan miktzat mattanot babbehonot venishpach hallog — yavi log [acher] veyatchil battechilla bemattanot shebbabbehonot. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: mimmakom sheppasak hu matchil. gamar mattanot shebbabbehonot venishpach hallog — divre hakkol mattenot harosh la meakkevot.
Ema: li shana rabbi yaakov balluggin.
Amar mar: mattenot harosh — en meakkevot. may tama? illema mishshum dichtiv: "vehannotar min hashshemen" — ella meatta: "vehannoteret min hammincha" hachi name dela meakkevi?!
Shane hatam, dichtiv: "umiyyeter ... vehannotar".
Amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo — banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbi elazar verabbi shimon. rabbi meir, deamar yavi acher veyatchil battechilla — hacha name yavi acher veyishchot.
Ulerabbi elazar verabbi shimon sheomrim mimmakom sheppasak mishsham hu matchil — hacha en lo takkana.
Matkef leh rav chisda: veha "oto" ketiv? kashya.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo, o shello natan middamo legabbe vehonot — hare ze ole legabbe mizbeach, vetaun nesachim, vetzarich asham acher lehacheshiro. verav chisda amar lecha: may tzarich — tzarich veen lo takkana.

Vetane tanna: "tzarich" — veen lo takkana? in, vehatanya: nazir memorat, bet shammay omrim: tzarich haavarat taar, uvet hillel omrim: en tzarich haavarat taar. veamar rabbi avina: kesheomrim bet shammay "tzarich", tzarich — veen lo takkana.

Ufeliga derabbi pedat. deamar rabbi pedat: bet shammay verabbi elazar amru davar echad. bet shammay — ha daamaran. rabbi elazar, (detanya:) en lo bohen yad uvohen regel — en lo tohora olamit. rabbi elazar omer: noten al mekomo veyotze. rabbi shimon omer: im natan al shel semol — yatza.
Tanu rabbanan: "velakach middam haasham", yachol bichli — talmud lomar: "venatan". ma netina beatzmo shel kohen — af lekicha beatzmo shel kohen.

Yachol af lammizbeach ken — talmud lomar: "ki kachattat haasham hu". ma chattat teuna keli — af asham taun keli. nimtzeta atta omer: asham metzora shene chohanim mekabbelim et damo, echad bayyad veechad bichli. ze shekkibbel bichli ba lo etzel mizbeach, veze shekkibbel bayyad ba lo etzel metzora.

Tenan hatam: vechullan metammeim begadim venisrafin abbet haddeshen, divre rabbi elazar verabbi shimon. vachachamim omrim: en metammein begadim, veen nisrafin abbet haddeshen ella haacharon, hoil vegamar bo kappara.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman: kamma seirim meshalleach? amar leh: vechi edro meshalleach? amar lo:

a: Vechi edro soref? mi dame — hatam la ketiv "oto", hacha ketiv "oto".

Ittemar, rav pappi mishshemeh derava amar: rishon meshalleach, verav shimi mishshemeh derava amar: acharon meshalleach. bishlama rav shimi (bar ashe) mishshemeh derava, deamar acharon meshalleach — kasavar: hoil vegamar bo kappara. ella rav pappi mishshemeh derava, may kasavar? savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: mitzva barishon.
He rabbi yose? illema rabbi yose dekuppot, ditnan (rabbi yose omer): shalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein shebbahem tormin et hallishka, vehaya katuv alehem 6.
Vetanya, amar rabbi yose: lamma katuv alehen 6 — leda eze mehen nitrema rishon, lehavi hemenna rishon, shemmitzva barishon.
Dilma beiddana deitchazay kammayyta, la itchazay batrayyta.

Ella rabbi yose defesach (ditnan): hammafrish pischo veavad, vehifrish acher tachtav, veachar kach nimtza harishon, vahare shenehen omdin — e ze mehen sheyyirtze yakriv, divre chachamim. rabbi yose omer: mitzva barishon, veim haya sheni muvechar mimmennu — yeviennu.
Hadaran alach hotziu lo
Shene seire yom hakkippurim — mitzvatan sheyyihyu shenehen shavin bammare uvakkoma uvaddamim uvilkichatan keechad. veaf al pi sheen shavin — kesherin. lakach echad hayyom veechad lemachar — kesherin.
Met echad mehem, im ad shello higril met — yikkach zug lashsheni. veim mishshehigril met — yavi zug acher veyagril alehem battechilla,

Veyomar: im shel shem met — ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav, veim shel azazel met — ze sheala alav haggoral laazazel yitkayyem tachtav. vehashsheni yire ad sheyyistaev, veyimmacher, veyippelu damav lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta. rabbi yehuda omer: tamut.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam — yamut hammishtalleach. met hammishtalleach — yishshafech haddam.
b: Gemara tanu rabbanan: "yikkach shene seire izzim", miut "seire" — shenayim. ma talmud lomar "shene"? sheyyihyu shenehen shavim. minnayin af al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin — talmud lomar: "sair" "sair" — ribba.
Tama derabbi rachamana, ha la rabbi rachamana — hava amena pesulin, ikkuva mena lan?
Salka datach amena, "shene" "shene" "shene" ketiv.
Vehasheta derabbi rachamana "sair" "sair", "shene" "shene" "shene", lema li? chad lemare, vechad lekoma, vechad ledamim.

Tanya name hachi gabbe kivse metzora: "yikkach shene kevasim", miut "kevasim" shenayim, ma talmud lomar "shene"? sheyyihyu shenehen shavin. uminnayin sheaf al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin — talmud lomar: "keves" "keves" — ribba.
Tama derabbi rachamana, ha la rabbi rachamana — hava amena pesulin, ikkuva mena lan? salka datach amena, "tihye" ketiv.
Vehasheta derabbi rachamana "keves" "keves" — "tihye" lema li? lishar havayato shel metzora.

(Utenan) name gabbe metzora ki hay gavvna: "tzipporim" — miut tzipporim (shenayim), ma talmud lomar "shete" — sheyyihyu shetehen shavot. uminnayin sheaf al pi sheenan shavot kesherot — talmud lomar: "tzippor" "tzippor" — ribba.
Tama derabbi rachamana, ha la rabbi rachamana — pesulot, ikkuva mena lan? salka datach amena, "tihye" ketiv.
Vehasheta derabbi rachamana "tzippor", "tihye" lema li? lishar havayato shel metzora.

I hachi, gabbe temidin name, nema: "kevasim" — miut kevasim shenayim, ma talmud lomar "shenayim" — sheyyihyu shenehen shavin. uminnayin sheaf al pi sheen shenehen shavin kesherin — talmud lomar: "keves" "keves" — ribba. ulemitzva hachi name devaenan?
Hahu mibbee leh lechidtanya: "shenayim layyom", keneged hayyom.

Atta omer keneged hayyom, o eno ella chovat hayyom? keshehu omer "et hakkeves echad taase vabboker veet hakkeves hashsheni taase ben haarbayim", hare chovat hayyom amur, uma ani mekayyem "shenayim layyom" — keneged hayyom.
Ketzad? tamid shel shachar haya nishchat al keren tzefonit maaravit, al tabbaat sheniyya. veshel ben haarbayim haya nishchat al keren mizrachit tzefonit, al tabbaat sheniyya.
Musafin shel shabbat, vadday tzerichin sheyyihyu shenehen shavin.
Tanu rabbanan: shene seire yom hakkippurim sheshshechatan bachutz, ad shello higril alehen — chayyayv al shenehem. mishshehigril alehen — chayyayv al shel shem, ufatur al shel azazel.
Ad shello higril alehem chayyayv al shenehem. lemay chazu? amar rav chisda: hoil verauy lesair hannaase bachutz.
Umay shena lesair hannaase bifnim dela, dimchussar hagerala? lesair hannaase bachutz name la chaze, dimchasseri avodat hayyom!
Kasavar rav chisda: en mechussar zeman levo bayyom.

Amar ravina: hasheta deamar rav chisda mechussar hagerala kimchussar maase dame, ha deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: shelamim sheshshechatan kodem shenniftechu daltot hahechol pesulin, shenneemar: "ushechato petach ohel moed", bizman shehu patuach, velo bizman shehu naul.

a: Shechatan bachutz kodem shenniftechu daltot hahechol — patur. may tama: mechussar peticha kimchussar maase dame.
Umi it leh lerav chisda "hoil"?
Vehaamar rav chisda: pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana, lishmo — patur, shello lishmo — chayyayv.
Tama deshello lishmo, ha setama, lishmo hu ufatur. veammay? lema: hoil verauy shello lishmo bifnim!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam bae akira, hay la bae akira.
Rabba bar shimi matne lehu bidrabba, vekashya leh derabba adderabba. umeshanne kidshanninan.
Ki ata rav dimi, amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana, ben lishmo ben shello lishmo — patur.
Amar rav dimi: amrita lishmata kammeh derabbi yirmeya bishlama lishmo, deha la chaze leh. ella shello lishmo, ammay? ha chaze shello lishmo bifnim?
Vaamar li: akirat chutz lav shema akira.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi yirmeya amar rabbi yochanan: pesach sheshshechato bachutz bishar yemot hashshana, ben lishmo ben shello lishmo — chayyayv.
Vaafillu lishmo? vehatnan: mechussar zeman — ben begufo, ben bivalim.
Veezehu mechussar zeman bivalim — hazzav vehazzava vehayyoledet vehametzora
Shehikrivu chattatam vaashamam bachutz — peturin. olotehen veshalmehen bachutz — chayyayvin.
Vaamar rav chilkiyya bar tovi: lo shanu ella lishmo, aval shello lishmo — chayyayv.
Lishmo miha patur, ammay? nema: hoil ureuyin shello lishmo bifnim! hachi hasheta?! hatam bae akira, hacha pesach bishar yemot hashshana — shelamim ninhu.
Rav ashe matne: chayyayv, kidamrinan. rav yirmeya middifti matne: patur. kasavar: pesach bishar yemot hashshana bae akira, vaakirat chutz lav shemah akira. ufeliga derav chilkiyya bar tovi.
Amar mar: mishshehigril alehen chayyayv al shel shem, ufatur al shel azazel.
Tanu rabbanan: "ish ish mibbet yisrael asher yishchat shor o chesev o ez bammachane o asher yishchat michutz lammachane. veel petach ohel moed lo hevio lehakeriv korban laAdonai".
b: I "korban", shomea ani afillu kodshe bedek habbayit, shennikreu korban, kainyan shenneemar: "vannakrev et korban Adonai", talmud lomar: "veel petach ohel moed lo hevio". kol harauy lefetach ohel moed — chayyayv alav bachutz, kol sheeno rauy lefetach ohel moed — en chayyayvin alav bachutz.

Otzi ellu sheen reuyin lefetach ohel moed, velo otzi parat chattat vesair hammishtalleach shehu rauy lavo el petach ohel moed, talmud lomar: "laAdonai", mi shemmeyuchadin laAdonai, yatzu ellu sheen meyuchadin lashshem.
Vela" lehotzi hu? ureminhu: "yeratze lekorban ishshe laAdonai", ellu ishshim,
Minnayin shello yakdishennu mechussar zeman — talmud lomar: "korban", "laAdonai" — lerabbot sair hammishtalleach!
Amar rava: hatam meinyana dikra vehacha meinyana dikra. hatam deel petach" lerabbot — "laAdonai" lehotzi. hacha deishshe" lehotzi — "laAdonai" lerabbot.
Tama derabbi rachamana, ha la rabbi, hava amena: sair hammishtalleach kadosh bimchussar zeman. veha en haggoral kovea ella berauy lashshem!
Amar rav yosef: ha manni, chanan hammitzri hi, detanya: chanan hammitzri omer: afillu dam bakkos — mevi chavero umezavvevg lo.
Emar deshamat leh lechanan hammitzri delet leh dechuyin, delet leh hagerala mi shamat leh? dilma mayyte umagril.
Ella amar rav yosef: ha manni, rabbi shimon hi. detanya: met echad mehen — mevi chavero shello behagerala, divre rabbi shimon.
Ravina amar, kegon shehumam vechillelo al acher.
Umena temra defasel beh muma! detanya: "veishshe lo tittenu mehem", ellu hachalavim.
En li ella kullan, miktzatan minnayin? talmud lomar: "mehem". "mizbeach", zo zerikat damim. "laAdonai", lerabbot sair hammishtalleach.

Veitzterich lemichtav baal mum, veitzterich lemichtav mechussar zeman. dei ketav rachamana mechussar zeman — mishshum dela mate zimneh, aval baal mum demate zimneh — ema la. vei ketav rachamana baal mum — mishshum dimis, aval mechussar zeman dela meis — ema la, tzericha.

a: Rava amar: kegon shehaya lo chole betoch beto, veshachat immo beyom hakkippurim.
Vechi hay gavvna mi asir? "lo tishchatu" amar rachamana, veha lav shechita hi! ha amri bemareva dechiyyayto latztzuk zo hi shechitato.
Im shel shem met, ze sheala alav vechulei.
Amar rav: sheni shebbezug rishon — yikrav, sheni shebbezug sheni — yire. rabbi yochanan amar: sheni shebbezug rishon — yire, sheni shebbazzug sheni — yikrav.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rav savar: baale chayyim enan nidchin, verabbi yochanan savar: baale chayyim nidchin.

May tama derav? deyalef mimmechussar zeman. mechussar zeman, lav af al gav dehashta la chaze, ki hadar michaze — shappir dame, hacha name la shena. mi dame? hatam la itchazi kelal. hacha nira venidcha!
Ella: hayeynu tama derav, deyalef mibbaal mum over. baal mum over, lav af al gav dela chaze hasheta, ki hadar michaze — shappir dame, hacha name la shena.
Vehatam mena lan? dichtiv: "ki moshchatam bahem mum bam", mum bam — hu delo yeratzu, ha avar muman — yeratzu.
Verabbi yochanan? miet rachamana "bahem", hem hu dechi avar muman yeratzu, ha kol dechuyin, hoil venidchu — nidchu.
Verav? hahu "bahem" beenayyhu hu dela mirtzu, ha al yede taarovot — mirtzu.

Keditnan: evarim temimim beevarim baale mumin. rabbi eliezer omer: im karav harosh shel echad mehen — yakrivu kol harashin kullan, keraav shel echad mehen — yakrivu kol hakkeraayim kullan. vachachamim omrim: afillu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen — yetze levet hasserefa.
Veiddach? nafka leh mibbam" "bahem". veiddach? "bam" "bahem" la daresh.
Ulerav, nehi name devaale chayyim enan nidchin, i bae hay nakrev i bae hay nakrev!

Amar rava: rav savar la kerabbi yose, deamar: mitzva barishon. he rabbi yose? i nema rabbi yose dekuppot, ditnan: shalosh kuppot shel shalosh shalosh sein, shebbahen tormin et hallishka, vechatuv alehen: alef bet gimel. vetanya, amar rabbi yose: lamma katuv alehen alef bet gimel — leda eze mehen nitrema rishon, lehavi hemenna rishon, shemmitzva barishon.
Dilma shane hatam, dividdana deitchazay kammayyta la itchazay batrayyta.

Ella rabbi yose defesach, (ditnan:) hammafrish pischo veavad, vehifrish acher tachtav, veachar kach nimtza harishon, vahare shenehen omdin — eze mehen sheyyirtze yikrav, divre chachamim. rabbi yose omer: mitzva barishon.
b: Veim haya hashsheni muvechar mimmennu — yeviennu.

Amar rava: dayka matnitin kevoteh derav, uvarayyta kevoteh derabbi yochanan. matnitin kevoteh derav, dekatane: im shel shem met — ze sheala alav haggoral lashshem yitkayyem tachtav, veiddach kidkae kae.

Barayyta kevoteh derabbi yochanan, dekatane: "sheni", eni yodea im sheni shebbezug rishon im sheni shebbezug sheni, keshehu omer "yoomad chay", velo shechavero met. may mashma? "yoomad chay", velo shekkevar amad.

Tenan, veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam — yamut hammishtalleach, met hammishtalleach — yishshafech haddam. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, deamar baale chayyim nidchin — mishshum hachi yamut hammishtalleach. ella lerav, deamar baale chayyim enan nidchin — ammay yamut hammishtalleach?
Amar lecha rav: allibba derabbi yehuda la ka amena. ki amena, allibba derabbanan.
Bishlama lerav, beha peligi rabbi yehuda verabbanan. ella lerabbi yochanan, bemay peligi? amar rava: ha amrinan dayyka matnitin kevoteh derav.
Tenan: sheen chattat tzibbur meta. ha deyachid ki hay gavvna — meta. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, kidrabbi abba amar rav. deamar rabbi abba amar rav:

a: Hakkol modim sheim nitkapper besheenah avuda — avuda meta.
Ella lerav have leh kemafrish shete chattaot leachrayut, veamar rabbi oshaya: hifrish shete chattaot leachrayut — mitkapper beachat mehem, vehashsheniyya tire.
Kevan deamar rava: rav savar la kerabbi yose deamar mitzva barishon, meikkara kemafrish leibbud dame.
Tenan, rabbi yehuda omer: tamut. bishlama lerabbi yochanan deamar sheni shebbezug rishon yire, lerabbi yehuda yamut — mitkapper bashsheni shebbezug sheni.
Ella lerav deamar sheni shebbezug sheni yire, lerabbi yehuda yamut — lerabbi yehuda bemay mikkappar? mi savrat rabbi yehuda ashsheni shebbezug sheni kae? rabbi yehuda ashsheni shebbezug rishon kae.
Veikka deka motev hachi: veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach, met hammishtalleach yishshafech haddam.
Bishlama lerav, resha peligi bechattat tzibbur vesefa peligi bevaale chayyim. ella lerabbi yochanan, may "veod". kashya.
Veod amar rabbi yehuda: nishpach haddam — yamut hammishtalleach. bishlama nishpach haddam yamut hammishtalleach — deakkatti la itavid mitzveteh.
Ella met hammishtalleach, ammay yishshafech haddam? ha itavid leh mitzveteh!
Amri deve rabbi yannay: amar kera: "yoomad chay lifne Adonai lechapper", ad matay yehe zakuk lihyot chay — ad sheat mattan damim shel chavero.
Tenan hatam: bene hair sheshshalchu et shiklehen venignevu o sheavdu, im nitrema teruma — nishbain legizbarin.
Veim lav — nishbain livne hair, uvene hair shoklin acherim tachtehen.
Nimtzeu o shehechzirum haggannavim — ellu vaellu shekalim hem, veen olin lahen leshana habbaa. rabbi yehuda omer: olin lahen leshana habbaa.
May tama derabbi yehuda? amar rava: kasavar rabbi yehuda chovot shel shana zo kerevot leshana habbaa.

Etiveh abbaye: par vesair shel yom hakkippurim sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen, vechen seire avoda zara sheavdu vehifrish acherim tachtehen — kullan yamutu, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi eliezer verabbi shimon omrim: yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru, veyippelu demehem lindava, sheen chattat tzibbur meta. amar leh:
b: Korbenot tzibbur ka amrat? shane korbenot tzibbur, kidrabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya. deamar rabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya: amar kera: "zot olat chodesh bechodsho", amra tora: chaddesh vehave li korban mitteruma chadasha.
Tinach sair, par may ikka lememar? gezera par attu sair.

Umishshum gezera yamutu? veod: ha derabbi tavi amar rabbi yoshiyya gufa mitzva hi. deamar rav yehuda amar shemuel: korbenot tzibbur habbain beechad benisan — mitzva lehavi min hechadash, veim hevi min hayyashan — yatza, ella shechisser mitzva!
Ella amar rabbi zera: lefi sheen haggoral kovea mishshana lachavertah. venayyte venagrel? gezera shemma yomru haggoral kovea mishshana lachavertah.
Ha tinach sair, par may ikka lememar? gezera par attu sair. umishshum gezera yamutu?
Amruha rabbanan kammeh deabbaye: gezera mishshum chattat shemmetu bealeha. ha tinach par, sair may ikka lememar? gezera sair attu par.
Umishshum gezera yamutu? ella: gezera mishshum chattat sheibbera shenatah. gezera? hi gufa chattat sheibbera shenatah hi!
Ha la kashya, kerabbi. detanya: "shana temima", mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yom keminyan yemot hachamma, divre rabbi. vachachamim omrim: mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom.

a: Veim nitabbera — nitabbera lammocher. hatinach sair, par may ikka lememar? gezera par attu sair.
Umishshum gezera yamut?! veod, chattat sheibbera shenatah — liriyya azla! deamar resh lakish: chattat sheibbera shenatah, roin otah keillu hi omedet bevet hakkevarot veroa.
Ella amar rava: gezera mishshum takkala. en makdishin, veen maarichin, veen machrimin bazzeman hazze.
Veim hikdish veheerich vehechrim, behema — teaker. perot kesut vechelim — yerakvu, maot uchele mattachot — yolich hanaa leyam hammelach. vee ze hu ikkur — noel delet lefaneha, vehi meta meeleha.
Takkala demay? i takkala dehakrava, afillu kol reiyyot name! i takkala degizza vaavoda, afillu kol reiyyot name!
Leolam takkala dehakrava, vehanach delav bene hakerava ninhu — la terid behu, hach devat hakerava hi — terid ba.
Vetakkala atzmah tannae hi. detanya chada: pesach shello karav berishon — yikrav bashsheni, bashsheni — yikrav leshana habbaa. vetanya iddach: lo yikrav. may lav, betakkala peligi?
La, dechulle alma [la] chayyshinan letakkala, vehacha biflugeta derabbi verabbanan ka mippalgi, vela kashya: ha rabbi, ha rabbanan.
Vehatanya: vechen hammaot! ella lav shema minna — betakkala peligi, shema minna.

Mishna ba lo etzel sair hammishtalleach, vesomech shete yadav alav umitvadde. vechach haya omer: ana hashshem! chatu, avu, pashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael. ana hashshem! kapper na lachataim velaavonot velappeshaim shechatu vesheavu vesheppashu lefanecha ammecha bet yisrael, kakkatuv betorat moshe avdecha lemor: "ki vayyom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem mikkol chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu".

Vehakkohanim vehaam haomdim baazara keshehayu shomim shem hammeforash shehu yotze mippi kohen gadol, hayu korim umishtachavim venoflim al penehem, veomrim: "baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed". mesaro lemi shehaya molicho. hakkol kesherin leholicho, ella sheasu hakkohanim gedolim keva, velo hayu mannichin et yisrael leholicho.
Amar rabbi yose: maase veholicho arsela, veyisrael haya. vechevesh asu lo mippene habbavliyyim, shehayu metalleshim bisaro veomrim lo: tol vatze tol vatze.
Gemara veillu "bene aharon am kedoshecha" la kaamar. man tanna? amar rabbi yirmeya: dela kerabbi yehuda, dei kerabbi yehuda, ha amar: yesh lahem kappara besair hammishtalleach.
Abbaye amar: afillu tema rabbi yehuda, attu kohanim lav bichlal "ammecha yisrael" ninhu?
Mesaro lemi shemmolicho. tanu rabbanan: "ish" — lehacheshir et hazzar, "itti" —
b: Sheyyehe mezumman. "itti" — vaafillu beshabbat, "itti" — vaafillu betumea.
"Ish" — lehacheshir et hazzar. peshita? mahu detema: "kappara" ketiva beh, ka mashma lan.
"Itti" vaafillu beshabbat. lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lomar, sheim haya chole — markivo al ketefo.
Keman, dela kerabbi natan. dei rabbi natan, haamar: chay nose et atzmo: afillu tema rabbi natan, chala shane.
Amar rafram, zot omeret: eruv vehotzaa leshabbat, veen eruv vehotzaa leyom hakkippurim.
"Itti" vaafillu betumea. lemay hilcheta? amar rav sheshet: lomar sheim nitma meshallecho — nichnas tame laazara, umeshallecho.

Shaalu et rabbi eliezer: chala, mahu sheyyarkivehu al ketefo? amar lahem: yachol hu leharekiv ani veattem. chala meshallecho, mahu sheyyeshallechennu beyad acher? amar lahem: ehe beshalom ani veattem.

Dechafo velo met, mahu sheyyered acharav vimitennu? amar lahem: "ken yovdu chol oyvecha Adonai". vachachamim omrim: chala — markivo al ketefo, chala meshallecho — yeshallechennu beyad acher. dechafo velo met — yered acharav vimitennu.
Shaalu et rabbi eliezer: peloni, mahu laolam habba? amar lahem lo sheeltuni ella al peloni.

Mahu lehatztzil roe kivsa min haari? amar lahem: lo sheeltuni ella al hakkivsa. mahu lehatztzil haroe min haari? amar lahem: lo sheeltuni ella al haroe. mamzer, ma hu lirash? mahu leyabbem? mahu lasud et beto? mahu lasud et kivro?
Lo mippene shehifligan bidvarim. ella mippene shello amar davar shello shama mippi rabbo meolam.

Shaala ishsha chachama et rabbi eliezer: meachar shemmaase haegel shavin, mippene ma en mitatan shava? amar lah: en chochma laishsha ella befelech, vechen hu omer: "vechol ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tavu".
Ittemar, rav velevi. chad amar: zibbeach vekitter — besayif. gippef venishshek — bemita. samach bilvavo — behidrokan.
Vechad amar: edim vehateraa — besayif, edim belo hateraa — bemita, lo edim velo hateraa — behidrokan.
Amar rav yehuda: shivto shel levi lo avad avoda zara, shenneemar: "vayyaamod moshe beshaar hammachane vegomer".
Yatev ravina vekaamar leha shemata. etiveh bene rav pappa bar abba leravina: "haomer leaviv uleimmo lo reitiv".
"Aviv" — avi immo miyyisrael, "echav" — echav meimmo miyyisrael, "banav" — bene vitto miyyisrael.

Vechevesh asu lo kulei. amar rabba bar bar chana: lo bavliyyim hayu, ella alekkesanderiyyim hayu. umittoch shessonim et habbavliyyim hayu korin otan al sheman. tanya rabbi yehuda omer: lo bavliyyim hayu, ella alekkesanderiyyim hayu. amar lo rabbi yose: tanuach datecha, shehinnachta et dati.
Tol vatze. tana: ma shahe tzafira den, vechove dara saggiin.
Mishna miyyakkire yerushalayim hayu melavvin oto ad sukka harishona. eser sukkot mirushalayim vead tzuk,

a: Tishim ris, shiva umechetza lechol mil. al kol sukka vesukka omrin lo: hare mazon, vahare mayim. umelavvin oto missukka lesukka, chutz meacharon shebbahen, sheeno maggia immo latztzuk, ella omed merachok veroe et maasav.

Me haya ose? cholek lashon shel zehorit chetzyo kashur bassela, vechetzyo kashur ben shene karnav. udechafo laachorav, vehu mitgalgel veyored. velo haya maggia lachatzi hahar ad shennaase evarim evarim. ba veyashav lo tachat sukka acharona ad shettechshach. umeematay metamme begadim — mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim, rabbi shimon omer: mishsheat dechiyyayto latztzuk.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: eser sukkot, ushenem asar milin hayu, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: tesha sukkot, vaasara milin. rabbi yose omer: chamesh sukkot, vaasara milin hayu. vechullan al yede eruv.
Amar rabbi yose: sach li elazar beni: im al yede eruv — yacholni laasot afillu shete sukkot vaasara milin.
Keman azla ha detanya: chutz meacharon shebbahen shello higgia immo latztzuk ella omed merachok veroe et maasav, keman kerabbi meir.
Al kol sukka vesukka omrim lo: hare mazon vahare mayim. tana: meolam lo hutzerach adam lechach, ella sheeno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo, lemi sheen lo pat besallo.
Me haya ose — cholek lashon shel zehorit. veniktereh kulleh besela? kevan demitzva besair, dilma kadem umalbin umiyyatteva dateh.
Veniktereh kulleh ben karnav? zimnin degamesh leh leresheh, velav addateh.

Tanu rabbanan: barishona hayu koshrin lashon shel zehorit al petach haulam mibbachutz, hilbin — hayu semechin, lo hilbin — hayu atzevin umitbayyeyshin. hitkinu sheyyihyu koshrin al petach ulam mibbifnim. vaadayin hayu metzitzin veroin, hilbin — hayu semechin, lo hilbin — hayu atzevin. hitkinu sheyyihyu koshrin oto chetzyo besela vechetzyo ben karnav.

Amar rabbi nachum bar pappa mishshum rabbi elazar hakkappar: barishona hayu koshrin lashon shel zehorit al petach ulam mibbifnim, vechevan shehiggia sair lammidbar haya malbin, veyadu shennaaset mitzvato. shenneemar: "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu".
Lo haya maggia lemachatzit hahar. ibbaya lehu: otan evarim ma hen bahanaa? rav ushemuel. chad amar: muttarin, vechad amar: asurin.
Man deamar muttarin,
b: Dichtiv: "bammidbar". uman deamar asurin, dichtiv: "gezera".
Uman deamar asurin, hay "midbar" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "hammidbara", "hammidbara", "bammidbar" — lerabbot nov vegivon, shilo, uvet olamim.
Veiddach, hay "gezera" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: "gezera" — en gezera ella chatucha. davar acher: en gezera ella davar hammitgazzer veyored.
Davar acher: "gezera", shemma tomar maase tohu hu, talmud lomar: "ani Adonai", ani Adonai gezartiv, veen lecha reshut lehareher bahen.
Amar rava: mistabbera keman deamar muttarin, lo amra tora "shallach" letakkala.

Tanu rabbanan: "azazel" — sheyyehe az vekashe. yachol bayyishshuv, talmud lomar: "bammidbar", uminnayin shebbetzuk? talmud lomar: "gezera". tanya iddach: "azazel" — kashe shebbeharim, vechen hu omer: "veet ele haaretz lakach".
Tana deve rabbi yishmael: "azazel" — shemmechapper al maase uzza veazzael.
Tanu rabbanan, "et mishpatay taasu" — devarim sheilmale (lo) nichtevu din hu sheyyikkatvu, veellu hen: avoda zara, vegilluy arayot, ushefichut damim, vegazel, uvirkat hashshem.

"Et chukkotay tishmeru" — devarim shehassatan meshiv alehen, veellu hen: achilat chazir, ulevishat shaatnez, vachalitzat yevama, vetohorat metzora, vesair hammishtalleach. veshemma tomar maase tohu hem, talmud lomar: "ani Adonai", ani Adonai chakaktiv, veen lecha reshut lehareher bahen.
Ematay metamme begadim. tanu rabbanan: hameshalleach metamme begadim, veen hashsholeach et hameshalleach metamme begadim.

Yachol mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat azara — talmud lomar: "hameshalleach". i "hameshalleach", yachol ad sheyyaggia latztzuk — talmud lomar: "vehameshalleach". ha ketzad: mishsheyyetze chutz lechomat yerushalayim, divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: "azazel vechibbes" — ad shehiggia latztzuk. rabbi shimon omer: "vehameshalleach et hassair laazazel yechabbes begadav", zorko bevat rosh umetamme begadim.
Mishna ba lo etzel par vesair hannisrafin, keraan, vehotzi et emurehen, netanan bemages vehiktiran al gabbe hammizbeach.
Kelaan bemiklaot vehotzian levet hasserefa. umeematay metammein begadim — mishsheyyetzu chutz lechomat haazara. rabbi shimon omer: mishsheyyatztzit haur berubban.
Gemara "vehiktiran" salka datach? ella ema: lehaketiran al gabbe mizbeach.

"Kelaan bemiklaot". amar rabbi yochanan: kemin kelia. tana: lo haya menattechan nittuach besar ola, ella or al gabbe basar. mena hane mille? detanya: rabbi omer: neemar kan or uvasar vaferesh, veneemar lehallan or uvasar vaferesh,

a: Ma lehallan, al yede nittuach velo al yede hefshet, af kan, al yede nittuach velo al yede hefshet.

Vehatam mena lan? detanya: "vekirbo ufirsho vehotzi" — melammed shemmotzio shalem. yachol yisrefennu shalem? neemar kan: "rosho ucheraav", veneemar lehallan: ("rosh ucheraayim"), ma lehallan al yede nittuach, af kan al yede nittuach.
I ma lehallan al yede hefshet, af kan al yede hefshet, talmud lomar: "vekirbo ufirsho". may talmuda? amar rav pappa: keshem sheppirsho bekirbo, kach besaro beoro.
Meematay metammein begadim. tanu rabbanan: "yotzi el michutz lammachane vesarfu".
Lehallan atta noten lahem shalosh machanot, vechan atta noten lahem machane achat? im ken lamma neemar "michutz lammachane", lomar lach: kevan sheyyatza chutz lemachane achat — metammeim begadim.
Vehatam mena lan? detanya: "vehotzi et kol happar" — chutz leshalosh machanot.

Atta omer chutz leshalosh machanot, o eno ella chutz lemachane achat? keshehu omer befar haeda "el michutz lammachane", sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar "vesaraf oto kaasher saraf et happar harishon", uma talmud lomar "el michutz lammachane" — litten lo machane sheniyya.
Ucheshehu omer "michutz lammachane" baddeshen, sheen talmud lomar, shehare kevar neemar: "el shefech haddeshen", ten lo machane shelishit.

Verabbi shimon, hay "michutz lammachane" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidtanya: rabbi eliezer omer: neemar kan "michutz lammachane" veneemar lehallan "michutz lammachane", ma kan chutz leshalosh machanot, af lehallan chutz leshalosh machanot. uma lehallan bemizrachah shel yerushalayim — af kan bemizrachah shel yerushalayim.
Verabbanan, hecha saref lehu? kidtanya: hechan nisrafin?
b: Litzfonah shel yerushalayim, vechutz leshalosh machanot. rabbi yose omer: abbet haddeshen nisrafin.

Amar rava: man tena diflig aleh derabbi yose — rabbi eliezer ben yaakov hu. detanya: "el shefech haddeshen yissaref", sheyyehe leshem deshen, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: sheyyehe mekomo meshuppach.
Amar leh abbaye: vedilma bimkomo meshuppach hu difligi.
Tanu rabbanan: "vehassoref" — hassoref metamme begadim velo hammatztzit et haur velo hamesadder et hammaaracha. vee zehu hassoref? ze hamesayyea bishat serefa.

Yachol af mishshennaasu efer metammein begadim — talmud lomar: "otam", otam metammein begadim, velo mishshennaasu efer metammein begadim. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: happar metamme, nittach habbasar eno metamme begadim.
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu deshavveye charocha.
Mishna amru lo lechohen gadol: higgia sair lammidbar. uminnayin hayu yodin shehiggia sair lammidbar? dirkaot hayu osin umenifin besudarin. veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar.
Amar rabbi yehuda, vahalo siman gadol haya lahem: mirushalayim vead bet chadodo, shelosha milin, holchin mil vechozrin mil, veshohin kede mil veyodin shehiggia sair lammidbar.

Rabbi yishmael omer: vahalo siman acher haya lahem: lashon shel zehorit haya kashur al pitcho shel hechol, ucheshehiggia sair lammidbar haya hallashon malbin, shenneemar: "im yihyu chataechem kashshanim kashsheleg yalbinu".
Gemara amar abbaye: shema minna bet chadodo bammidbar kayyma, veha ka mashma lan dekasavar rabbi yehuda: kevan shehiggia sair lammidbar — naaset mitzvato.
Hadaran alach shene seire
Ba lo kohen gadol likrot, im ratza likrot bevigde vutz — kore, veim lav — kore beitztelit lavan mishshello.

Chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora, venotno lerosh hakkeneset, verosh hakkeneset notno lassegan, vehassegan notno lechohen gadol, vechohen gadol omed umekabbel, vekore beachare mot" veach beasor", vegolel sefer tora umannicho becheko veomer: yoter mimma shekkarati lifnechem katuv kan. "uveasor" shebbechomesh happekudim kore al pe.

Umevarech aleha shemone berachot: al hattora, veal haavoda, veal hahodaa, veal mechilat heavon, veal hammikdash bifne atzmo, veal yisrael bifne atzman, veal yerushalayim bifne atzmah, veal hakkohanim bifne atzman, veal shear hattefilla.

Haroe kohen gadol keshehu kore — eno roe par vesair hannisrafin, veharoe par vesair hannisrafin — eno roe kohen gadol keshehu kore. velo mippene sheeno rashshay, ella shehayta derech rechoka, umelechet shenehen shava keachat.
Gemara middekatane beitztelit lavan mishshello, mikkelal dikria lav avoda hi.
Vekatane: im ratza likrot bevigde vutz — kore, shamat minna bigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahen! dilma shane keria detzorech avoda hi.
Deibbaya lan: bigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahen, o lo nittenu lehanot bahen.

Ta shema: lo hayu yeshenim bevigde kodesh. shena hu dela, ha mechol — achli! dilma shane achila detzorech avoda hi, kidtanya: "veachlu otam asher kuppar bahem" — melammed shehakkohanim ochlim uvealim mitkapperin.
Shena hu dela, ha halloche — mehallechi! bedin hu dehalloche name la,

a: Vesefa itztericha leh: poshtin umekappelin umannichin tachat rashehem.

Poshtin umekappelin umannichin otan tachat rashehen, shamat minna bigde kehunna nittenu lehanot bahen! amar rav pappa: la tema tachat rashehen, ella ema keneged rashehen. amar rav mesharsheya: shamat minna tefillin min hatztzad shappir dame.
Hachi name mistabbera dichneged rashehen, dei salka datach tachat rashehen, vetippok li mishshum kilayim — deha ikka avnet. unehi name denittenu lehanot bahen — ha mithane mikkilayim!
Hanicha leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot. ella leman deamar avneto shel kohen gadol lo ze hu avneto shel kohen hedyot, may ikka lememar!

Vechi tema: kilayim bilvisha vehaalaa — hu daasir, behatztzaa shere, vehatanya: "lo yaale alecha", aval atta muttar lehatztzio tachtecha. aval amru chachamim: asur laasot ken, shemma tikkarech nima achat al besaro.

Vechi tema demafsek leh midde bene bene — vehaamar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar rabbi mishshum kehala kaddisha shebbirushalayim: afillu eser matztzaot zo al gav zo vechilayim tachtehen — asur lishan alehen. ella lav shema minna: keneged rashehen, shema minna.
Rav ashe amar: leolam tachat rashehen, veha ka mithane mikkilayim — bigde chehunna kashin hen. ki ha deamar rav huna bereh derabbi yehoshua: hay namta gamda denaresh — sharya.
Ta shema: bigde chehunna, hayyotze bahen lammedina — asur. uvammikdash, ben bishat avoda ben shello bishat avoda — muttar, mippene shebbigde chehunna nittenu lehanot bahen. shema minna.
Uvammedina la? vehatanya: beesrim vachamishsha [betevet] yom har gerizim [hu], dela lemispad?

Yom shebbikkeshu kutiyyim et bet elohenu mealekkesanderos mokdon lehacherivo, venatnu lahem. bau vehodiu et shimon hatztzaddik. me asa? lavash bigde chehunna, venitattef bevigde chehunna, umiyyakkire yisrael immo, vaavukot shel or bidehen. vechol hallayla, hallalu holchim mitztzad ze, vehallalu holchim mitztzad ze, ad sheala ammud hashshachar.

Kevan sheala ammud hashshachar, amar lahem: mi hallalu? amru lo: yehudim shemmardu becha. kevan shehiggia leantippatres zarcha chamma ufagu ze baze. kevan sheraa leshimon hatztzaddik, yarad mimmerkavto vehishtachava lefanav. amru lo: melech gadol kemotcha yishtachave lihudi ze?! amar lahem: demut deyokno shel ze menatztzachat lefanay bevet milchamti.

Amar lahem: lamma batem? amru: efshar bayit shemmitpallelim bo alecha veal malchutecha shello techrav, yatucha goyim lehacherivo? amar lahem: mi hallalu? amru lo: kutiyyim hallalu, sheomdim lefanecha. amar lahem: hare hem mesurin bidechem.

Miyyad nekavum beikvehem utelaum bezanve susehem, vehayu megarrin otan al hakkotzim veal habbarkanim, ad shehiggiu lehar gerizim. kevan shehiggiu lehar gerizim — charashuhu, uzerauhu karshinin, kederech shebbikkeshu laasot levet elohenu. veoto hayyom asauhu yom tov.
I baet ema: reuyin levigde chehunna. vei baet ema: "et laasot laAdonai heferu toratecha".
Chazzan hakkeneset notel sefer tora: shema minna cholkin kavod letalmid bimkom harav! amar abbaye: kullah mishshum kevodo dechohen gadol hi.
Vechohen gadol omed. mikkelal shehu yoshev, veha anan tenan:
b: En yeshiva baazara ella lemalche bet david bilvad. shenneemar: "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai"? kidamar rav chisda — beezrat nashim, hacha name — beezrat nashim.

Vehecha ittemar derav chisda? aha. metivi: detanya, hechan korin bo — baazara, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: behar habbayit, shenneemar: "vayyikra vo lifne harchov asher lifne shaar hammayim", veamar rav chisda: beezrat nashim.
"Vayvarech ezra et Adonai haelohim haggadol". may "gadol"? amar rav yosef amar rav: sheggiddelo beshem hameforash. rav giddel amar: "baruch Adonai elohe yisrael min haolam vead haolam".
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: vedilma sheggiddelo beshem hameforash? amar leh: en omrim shem hameforash bigvulim.
Vela? vehachtiv: "vayyaamod ezra hassofer al migdal etz asher asu laddavar". veamar rav giddel: sheggiddelo beshem hameforash! horaat shaa hayta.

"Vayyitzaku el Adonai elohim bekol gadol". may amur? amar rav, veittema rabbi yochanan: biyyay biyyay hayeynu hay deachreveh lemakdesha vekalye lehechleh vekatlinhu lechullehu tzaddike veaglinhu leyisrael mearahon, vaadayin merakked benan. kelum yehavteh lan ella lekabbole beh agra? la ihu baenan, vela agreh baenan!
Nefal lehu pitka merkia, dahava ketiv be "emet".
Amar rav chanina: shema minna chotamo shel hakkadosh baruch hu "emet".

Otivu betaanita telata yomin utelata lelavata, masruhu nihalayhu. nefak ata ki gureya denura mibbet kadshe hakkodashim, amar lehu navi leyisrael: hayeynu yitzra daavoda zara, shenneemar: "vayyomer zot harisha".

Bahade detafsu leh ishtemit binita mimmazzeye urema kala, vaazal kaleh arba mea parse. amru: hechi naaved? dilma chas veshalom merachami aleh min shemayya. amar lehu navi: shadyuhu beduda daavara, vechafyuhu lefummeh baavara, daavara mishav shaev kala, shenneemar: "vayyomer zot harisha vayyashlech otah el toch haefa vayyashlech et even haoferet el piha".
Amaru: hoil veet ratzon hu, nive rachame ayyitzra daavera. beo rachame veimmesar bidayyhu.

Amar lehu: chazo, dei katlitu leh lehahu, kale alma. chavshuhu telata yome, uvau beata bat yoma bechol eretz yisrael vela ishtechach. amri: hechi naaved? nikteleh — kale alma, nive rachame appalga — palga birkia la yahavi. kachlinhu leeneh veshavkuhu, veahni dela miggare beh leinish bekarivte.
Bemareva matnu hachi: rav giddel amar: "gadol" — sheggiddelo beshem hameforash, verav matna amar: "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora".

Veha derav matna matyay lidrabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: lamma nikra sheman anshe keneset haggedola — shehechziru atara leyoshnah. ata moshe, amar: "hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora". ata yirmeya vaamar: goyim mekarkerin behechalo, ayye norotav? la amar "nora". ata daniel amar: goyim mishtabedim bevanav, ayye gevurotav? la amar "gibbor".

Ato inhu veamru: adderabba, zo hi (gevurat) gevurato: shekkovesh et yitzro — shennoten erech appayim larshaim. veellu hen norotav — sheilmale morao shel hakkadosh baruch hu heach umma achat yechola lehitkayyem ben haummot?
Verabbanan: hechi avdi hachi veakri takkanta detakken moshe? amar rabbi elazar: mittoch sheyyodin behakkadosh baruch hu sheamitti hu, lefichach lo kizzevu bo.
Vekore "achare mot" veach beasor". ureminhi: medallegin bannavi, veen medallegin battora!
La kashya: kan, bichde sheyyafsik hatturegman. kan, bichde shello yafsik hatturegman.
Veha ala katane: medallegin bannavi, veen medallegin battora. vead kamma medalleg — bichde shello yafsik hatturegman, ha battora — kelal kelal la!
Amar abbaye, la kashya: kan, beinyan echad. kan, bishne inyanin.
Vehatanya: medallegin battora beinyan echad, uvannavi bishne inyanin. kan vechan bichde shello yafsik hatturegman. veen medallegin minnavi lenavi. uvannavi shel shenem asar medallegin,

a: Uvilvad shello yedalleg missof hassefer litchillato.
Vegolel sefer tora vechulei. vechol kach lamma — kede shello lehotzi laaz al sefer tora.
"Uveasor" shel chomesh happekudim kore al pe. ammay? niglol venikre! amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua amar rav sheshet: lefi sheen gollin sefer tora betzibbur, mippene kevod tzibbur.
Venayyte acharina venikre! rav huna bar yehuda amar: mishshum pegamo shel rishon. veresh lakish amar: mishshum beracha sheenah tzericha.

Umi chayyshinan lifgama? vehaamar rabbi yitzchak nappacha: rosh chodesh tevet shechal lihyot beshabbat meviin shalosh torot vekorin achat beinyano shel yom, veachat shel rosh chodesh, veachat shel chanukka.
Telata gavre bitlata sifre — lekka pegama, chad gavra bitre sifre — ikka pegama.

Umevarech aleha shemone berachot. tanu rabbanan: al hattora — kederech shemmevarchim bevet hakkeneset, al haavoda, veal hahodaa, veal mechilat heavon ketiknah. veal hammikdash bifne atzmo, veal hakkohanim bifne atzman, veal yisrael bifne atzman, veal shear tefilla.

Tanu rabbanan: ushear hattefilla "rinna techinna bakkasha millefanecha al ammecha yisrael shetztzerichin lehivvasha" vechotem beshomea tefilla. veachar kach, kol echad veechad mevi sefer tora mibbeto, vekore bo kede lehareot chazuto lerabbim.
Haroe kohen gadol kulei lo mippene sheeno rashshay. peshita? mahu detema kidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish: en maavirin al hammitzvot.
Umay mitzva — "berov am haderat melech", ka mashma lan.
Mishna im bevigde vutz kore, kiddesh yadav veraglav. pashat, yarad vetaval, ala venistappag, veheviu lo bigde zahav velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav,

Veyatza veasa et elo veet el haam veet shivat kevasim temimim bene shana, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi akiva omer: im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin. ufar haola vesair hannaase bachutz — hayu kerevin im tamid shel ben haarbayim.
Kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat, veyarad vetaval veala venistappag.
Heviu lo bigde lavan velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav. nichnas lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta. kiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat, veyarad vetaval ala venistappag.
Heviu lo bigde zahav velavash, vekiddesh yadav veraglav, venichnas lehaketir ketoret shel ben haarbayim, ulehetiv et hannerot, vekiddesh yadav veraglav ufashat, veyarad vetaval ala venistappag.
Heviu lo bigde atzmo velavash, umelavvin oto ad beto. veyom tov haya ose leohavav beshaa sheyyatza beshalom min hakkodesh.
Gemara ibbaya lehu: hechi kaamar, im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin, ufar haola vesair hannaase bachutz im tamid shel ben haarbayim,
O dilma hachi kaamar: im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin, ufar haola bahadayyhu, vesair hannaase bachutz im tamid shel ben haarbayim.
Vetu: par haola lerabbi eliezer deshayyeyreh, emat aved leh?
Vetu: ben lerabbi eliezer ben lerabbi akiva, emure chattat emat aved lehu?
Amar rava: la mashkachat la metakkanta, ella o lerabbi eliezer detana bidve shemuel, o lerabbi akiva kidtosefta.
Detana deve shemuel: rabbi eliezer omer: yatza veasa elo veel haam veemure chattat, aval par haola veshivat kevasim vesair hannaase bachutz — im tamid shel ben haarbayim.

Rabbi akiva detosefta may hi? detanya, rabbi akiva omer: par haola veshivat kevashim im tamid shel shachar hayu kerevin, shenneemar: "millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid", veachar kach avodat hayyom.
b: Veachar kach sair hannaase bachutz, shenneemar: "seir izzim echad chattat millevad chattat hakkippurim", veachar kach elo veel haam, veachar kach emure chattat, veachar kach tamid shel ben haarbayim.
May tama derabbi eliezer? aved kedichtiv: aved beresha detorat kohanim, vahadar aved dechomesh happekudim.
Verabbi akiva? kidkatane tama: "millevad olat habboker asher leolat hattamid", alma musafin im tamid shel shachar aved lehu.
Verabbi eliezer, hay "millevad chattat hakkippurim" may aved leh? hahu mibbee leh, al ma shezze mechapper — ze mechapper.

Rabbi yehuda omer mishshemo: echad karev im tamid shel shachar, veshishsha im tamid shel ben haarbayim. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer mishshemo: shishsha kerevin im tamid shel shachar, veechad im tamid shel ben haarbayim.
May tamayyhu derabbanan? tere kerae ketivi. ketiv: "millevad olat habboker", uchetiv: "veyatza veasa et olato", hilkach, aved minnayyhu hacha umanayyhu hacha.
Bemay ka mippalgi? rabbi yehuda savar: aved chad kedichtiv: "millevad olat habboker", vahadar aved avodat hayyom — dilma chulesha chalesh kohen gadol.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar: kevan deatchel — aved shishsha, dilma pasha. dilgabbe avodat hayyom — zariz hu.

Dechulle alma mihat, chad ayil hu. keman — kerabbi. detanya, rabbi omer: ayil echad haamur kan, hu haamur bechomesh happekudim. rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: shene elim hen, echad haamur kan, veechad haamur bechomesh happekudim.
May tama derabbi? dichtiv: "echad". verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, may "echad"? meyuchad shebbeedro.
Verabbi? nafka leh: mimmivchar nedarecha". verabbi elazar berabbi shimon? chad bechova, vechad bindava. utzerichi.
Kiddesh yadav veraglav. tanu rabbanan: "uva aharon el ohel moed". lama hu ba? lehotzi et hakkaf veet hammachta,

a: Shekkol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder, chutz mippasuk ze.
May tama? amar rav chisda: gemiri, chamesh tevilot vaasara kiddushin tovel kohen gadol umekaddesh bo bayyom,
Vei amrat kesidran ketivi, la mashkachat la ella shalosh tevilot veshishsha kiddushin.
Matkef la rabbi zera: vedilma mafsek leh besair hannaase bachutz!
Amar abbaye, amar kera: "veyatza veasa et olato", mitzia rishona aved elo veel haam.
Rava amar, amar kera: "ufashat et bigde habbad", sheen talmud lomar "asher lavash", kelum adam poshet ella ma shellovesh?! ella ma talmud lomar "asher lavash" — shellavash kevar.
Matkef la rabba bar rav shela: veema demafsek leh besair hannaase bachutz! hachtiv: "veyatza veasa".

Vechol happarasha kullah neemra al hasseder? veha kerae ketivi: "veet chelev hachattat yaktir hammizbecha", vahadar: "veet par hachattat veet seir hachattat", veillu anan tenan: haroe et kohen gadol keshehu kore — eno roe par vesair hannisrafin. veillu emure chattat batar hachi makter lehu!
Ema: chutz mippasuk ze veelach.
Umay chazet dimshabbeshat kerae, shabbesh matnita!
Amar abbaye, amar kera: "vehameshalleach ... vehassoref". ma meshalleach demeikkara — af soref demeikkara.
Adderabba: ma soref dehashta — af meshalleach dehashta!
"Vehameshalleach", demeikkara mashma. rava amar, amar kera: "yoomad chay", ad matay yehe zakuk laamod chay? ad sheat kappara. veematay sheat kappara? bishat mattan damim, vetu la.
Ate meshalleach, metzao bashshuk lechohen gadol, omer lo: ishi kohen gadol! asinu shelichutecha. metzao beveto, omer lo: mechayye chayyim, asinu shelichuto.
Amar rabba: ki mippatri rabbanan mehadade befumebdita amri hachi: "mechayye chayyim yitten lecha chayyim arukkim vetovim umetukkanin".
"Ethallech lifne Adonai beartzot hachayyim", amar rav yehuda: ze makom shevavkim.
"Ki orech yamim ushenot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach", vechi yesh shanim shel chayyim veyesh shanim sheenan shel chayyim? amar rabbi elazar: ellu shenotav shel adam hammithappechot alav meraa letova.

"Alechem ishim ekra", amar rabbi berechya: ellu talmide chachamim, sheddomin lenashim veosin gevura kaanashim. veamar rabbi berechya: harotze lenassech yayin al gabbe hammizbeach — yemalle geronam shel talmide chachamim yayin, shenneemar: "alechem ishim ekra".
Veamar rabbi berechya: im roe adam shettora poseket mizzaro — yissa bat talmid chacham, shenneemar: "im yazkin baaretz shorsho uveafar yamut gizo
b: Mereach mayim yafriach veasa katzir kemo nata".

Veyom tov haya ose leohavav. tanu rabbanan: maase bechohen gadol echad sheyyatza mibbet hammikdash vahavo azli kulle alma batreh. kevan dechazyunehu lishmaya veavtalyon, shavkuhu ledideh veazli batar shemaya veavtalyon.

Lesof ato shemaya veavtalyon leippetore minneh dechohen gadol. amar lahen: yeton bene ammin lishlam. amaru leh: yeton bene ammin lishlam deavdin ovada deaharon, vela yete bar aharon lishlam dela aved ovada deaharon.

Mishna kohen gadol meshammesh bishmona kelim, vehahedyot bearbaa: bichtonet umichnasayim umitznefet veavnet. mosif alav kohen gadol: choshen veefod umeil vetzitz. beellu nishalin beurim vetummim. veen nishalin ella lemelech uleav bet din ulemi shehatztzibbur tzarich bo.
Gemara tanu rabbanan, devarim shenneemar bahen "shesh" chutan kaful shishsha. "moshzar" shemona. meil shenem asar. parochet esrim vearbaa. choshen veefod esrim ushemona.

Chutan kaful shishsha mena lan — deamar kera: "vayyaasu et hakkotnot shesh ... veet hammitznefet shesh veet paare hammigbaot shesh veet michnese habbad shesh moshzar". chamsha kerae ketivi: chad legufeh, dechittana nihvo. vechad, sheyyehe chutan kaful shishsha. vechad, sheyyihyu shezurin. vechad, lishar begadim shello neemar bahen shesh. vechad, leakkev.

May mashma dehay "shesh" kittana hu? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: deamar kera "bad" — davar haole min hakkarka bad bad. veema amra! amra ippetzole mippatzla. kittana name ippetzole mippetzil! kittana aggav lakuteh mippetzil.
Ravina amar mehacha: "paare fishtim yihyu al rosham umichnese fishtim yihyu al motnehem".

Amar leh rav ashe: ha mikkamme deate yechezkel, man amra? uletamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, middivre yechezkel ben buzi lamadnu: "kol ben nechar erel lev veerel basar lo yavo el mikdashi" — ha mikkamme deate yechezkel, man amra? ella gemara gemiri la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera. hacha name: gemara gemiri la, vaata yechezkel veasmecha akkera.

"Moshzar" shemona. mena lan? dichtiv: "vayyaasu al shule hammeil rimmone techelet veargaman vetolaat shani moshzar", veyalef "moshzar" "moshzar" mipparochet, ma lehallan esrim vearbaa — af kan esrim vearbaa, dahava kol chad vechad tamne.

Venelaf mechoshen veefod: ma lehallan esrim ushemona, af kan esrim ushemona! danin davar shello neemar bo zahav, middavar shello neemar bo zahav, leappoke choshen veefod shenneemar bahen zahav. adderabba: danin beged mibbeged, leappoke parochet — deohel hu!
Ella: danin meavnet, vedanin beged vedavar shello neemar bo zahav, mibbeged vedavar shello neemar bo zahav, veen danin davar sheen bo zahav middavar sheyyesh bo zahav.
Rav mari amar: "taasennu" ketiv. taasennu laze, velo leacher.

Rav ashe amar: "veasita" ketiv, sheyyihyu kol asiyyot shavot. vehechi nebed? nebed telata deasra asra — havu lehu telatin! nebed tere detisha tisha vechad deasra — amar kera: "veasita", sheyyihyu kol asiyyotav shavot.
Meil shenem asar, mena lan — dichtiv: "veasita et meil haefod

a: Kelil techelet", veyalef "techelet" "techelet" mipparochet: ma lehallan shishsha, af kan shishsha.
Venelaf mishshulav verimmonav — ma lehallan shemona, af kan shemona! danin keli mikkeli, veen danin keli mittachshit keli.
Adderabba: danin gufo miggufo, veen danin gufo mealma. hayeynu deamrinan: lishar begadim shello neemar bahen "shesh".
Parochet esrim vearbaa — arbea deshitta shitta, la dina vela dayyayna.

Choshen veefod esrim ushemona mena lan? dichtiv: "veasita choshen mishpat maase choshev kemaase efod taasennu zahav techelet veargaman vetolaat shani veshesh moshzar", arbea deshitta shitta — esrin vearbea, zahav — arbea, ha esrin utemanya.
Veema zahav name shishsha! amar rav acha bar yaakov, amar kera: "vekitztzetz petilim". "petil", "petilim" — hare kan arbaa.

Rav ashe amar, amar kera: "laasot betoch hattechelet uvetoch haargaman". hechi naaved? naaved arbea ditre tere — havu lehu temanya. naaved tere ditre tere, utere dechad chad — "veasita", sheyyihyu kol asiyyotav shavot.

Amar rachava amar rav yehuda: hamekarea bigde chehunna loke, shenneemar: "lo yikkarea". matkef la rav acha bar yaakov, vedilma hachi kaamar rachamana: naaved leh safa ki hechi dela nikkera! mi ketiv "shello yikkarea"?

Amar rabbi elazar: hammazziach choshen meal haefod, vehammesir badde aron — loke, shenneemar: "lo yizzach" vela yasuru". matkef la rav acha bar yaakov: vedilma ki kaamar rachamana, chaddekinhu veavdinhu shappir kede shello yizzach velo yasuru! mi ketiv "shello yizzach" veshello yasuru"?!
Rabbi yose berabbi chanina rame, ketiv: "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim lo yasuru mimmennu", uchetiv: "vehuva et baddav battabbaot"! ha ketzad? mitparkin veen nishmatin.

Tanya name hachi: "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim". yachol lo yihyu zazin mimmekoman? talmud lomar: "vehuva et baddav battabbaot", i "vehuva et baddav", yachol yihyu nichnasin veyotzin — talmud lomar: "betabbeot haaron yihyu habbaddim". ha ketzad? mitparkin, veen nishmatin.

Amar rabbi chama berabbi chanina, may dichtiv: "atze shittim omdim", sheomdim derech gedilatan. davar acher: "omdim", shemmaamidin et tzippuyayn. davar acher: "omdim". shemma tomar avad sivran uvatel sikkuyayn — talmud lomar: "omdim", sheomdin leolam uleolamim.
Amar rabbi chama bar chanina, may dichtiv: "et bigde hasserad lesharet bakkodesh" —
b: Ilmale bigde chehunna, lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit.
Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: deve rabbi shimon tana: begadim sheggordin otan kivriyyaytan mikkelehen, umesardin mehen kelum. may hi? resh lakish amar: ellu maase machat.

Metivi: bigde chehunna en osin otan maase machat, ella maase oreg, shenneemar: "maase oreg"! amar abbaye: lo nitzrecha ella levet yad shellahem. kidtanya: bet yad shel bigde chehunna neereget bifne atzmah, venidbeket im habbeged, umaggaat ad pissat hayyad.
Amar rachava amar rav yehuda: shalosh aronot asa betzalel, emtzai shel etz tisha, penimi shel zahav shemona, chitzon asara umashshehu.
Vehatanya: achad asar umashshehu! la kashya: ha keman deamar yesh beovyo tefach, ha keman deamar en beovyo tefach. umay mashshehu — zer.

Amar rabbi yochanan, shelosha zerim hen: shel mizbeach, veshel aron, veshel shulchan. shel mizbeach — zacha aharon unetalo. shel shulchan — zacha david unetalo. shel aron — adayin munnach hu, kol harotze likkach — yavo veyikkach. shemma tomar pachut hu, talmud lomar: "bi melachim yimlochu".
Rabbi yochanan rame. ketiv: "zar", vekarenan "zer". zacha — naaset lo zer, lo zacha — zara hemennu.
Rabbi yochanan rame. ketiv: "veasita lecha aron etz", uchetiv: "veasu aron atze shittim", mikkan letalmid chacham, shebbene iro metzuvvivyn laasot lo melachto.
"Mibbayit umichutz tetzappennu". amar rava: kol talmid chacham sheen tocho kevaro — eno talmid chacham.
Amar abbaye veittema rabba bar ulla: nikra nitav, shenneemar: "af ki nitav veneelach ish shote chammayim avla".

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan, may dichtiv: "lamma ze mechir beyad kesil liknot chochma velev ayin" — oy lahem lesonehen shel talmide chachamim, sheoskin battora veen bahen yirat shamayim.
Machriz rabbi yannay: chaval al delet leh darta, vetara ledarteh aved.
Amar lehu rava lerabbanan: bematuta minnayychu, la tirtun tarte gehinnam.

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, may dichtiv: "vezot hattora asher sam moshe", zacha — naaset lo sam chayyim, lo zacha — naaset lo sam mita. vehayeynu deamar rava: deomen la — samma dechayyay, dela omen la — samma demota.

Amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani, rabbi yonatan rame, ketiv: "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev", uchetiv: "imrat Adonai tzerufa". zacha — mesammachto, lo zacha — tzorafto. resh lakish amar, miggufeh dikra nafka: zacha — tzorafto lechayyim, lo zacha — tzorafto lemita.
"Yirat Adonai tehora omedet laad". amar rabbi chanina: ze hallomed tora betohora. may hi? nose ishsha, veachar kach lomed tora.
"Edut Adonai neemana", amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: neemana hi lehaid belomdeha.
"Maase rokem", "maase choshev", amar rabbi elazar: sherokmin bimkom shechoshvin.
Tana mishshemeh derabbi nechemya: "rokem" — maase machat, lefichach partzuf echad. "choshev" — maase oreg, lefichach shene partzufot.

Beellu nishalin beurim vetummim. ki ata rav dimi, amar: begadim shekkohen gadol meshammesh bahen, meshuach milchama meshammesh bahen, shenneemar: "uvigde hakkodesh asher leaharon yihyu levanav acharav", lemi shebba bigdulla acharav.
Metiv rav adda bar ahava, veamri la kedi: yachol yehe beno shel meshuach milchama meshammesh tachtav kederech shebbeno shel kohen gadol meshammesh tachtav —

a: Talmud lomar: "shivat yamim yilbasham hakkohen tachtav mibbanav asher yavo el ohel moed", mi sherauy lavo el ohel moed. veim ita — michze chaze!
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, hachi kaamar: kol sheikkar meshichato leohel moed. yatza ze, sheikkar meshichato lemilchama.
Metivi: meshuach milchama eno meshammesh lo bearbaa kechohen hedyot, lo bishmona kechohen gadol.
Amar leh abbaye: ella zar meshavvet leh! ella: kechohen gadol — mishshum eva, kechohen hedyot — mishshum maalin bakkodesh velo moridin.
Amar leh rav adda bar abba lerava: vehay tanna delet leh eva, vela ka meshammesh.
Detanya, devarim shebben kohen gadol lechohen hedyot: par kohen mashiach, ufar habba al kol hammitzvot, ufar yom hakkippurim, vaasirit haefa.
Lo porea, velo porem, aval porem hu millematta, vehahedyot milmala. veen mittamme likrovav, umetzuvvev al habbetula, umuzehar al haalmana, umachazir et harotzeach.

Umakriv onen, veeno ochel, veeno cholek, venotel chelek barosh, umakriv chelek barosh. umeshammesh bishmona kelim, ufatur al tumeat mikdash vekadashav, vechol avodot yom hakkippurim enan kesherot ella bo.
Vechullan nohagot bimrubbe begadim, chutz mippar habba al kol hammitzvot.
Vechullan nohagot bemashuach sheavar, chutz mippar yom hakkippurim vaasirit haefa.

Vechullan en nohagot bimshuach milchama, chutz mechamishsha devarim haamurin bapparasha: lo porea, velo porem, velo mittamme likrovav, umetzuvvev al habbetula, umuzehar al haalmana, umachzir et harotzeach kedivre rabbi yehuda, vachachamim omrim: eno machzir.
Ki let leh eva — bedichvoteh, bidzutar minneh — it leh.

Yetev rabbi avahu vekaamar la leha shemata mishshemeh derabbi yochanan. ahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayyhu. ikka deamri, rabbi chiyyay bar abba amara, veahderinhu rabbi amme verabbi assi leappayyhu.
Matkef la rav pappa: bishlama rabbi avahu — mishshum yekara deve kesar, ella lerabbi chiyyay bar abba — nemru leh memar: la amar rabbi yochanan hachi.
Ki ata ravin, amar: nishal ittemar. tanya name hachi: begadim shekkohen gadol meshammesh bahen — meshuach milchama nishal bahen.
Tanu rabbanan: ketzad shoalin? hashshoel panav kelappe nishal, vehannishal panav kelappe shechina.
Hashshoel omer: "erdof achare haggedud hazze", vehannishal omer: "ko amar Adonai ale vehatzelach". rabbi yehuda omer: en tzarich lomar "ko amar Adonai", ella "ale vehatzelach".
En shoalin bekol, shenneemar: "veshaal lo". lo mehareher belibbo, shenneemar: "veshaal lo lifne Adonai", ella kederech sheamra channa bitfillatah, shenneemar: "vechanna hi medabberet al libbah".

En shoalin shene devarim keechad. veim shaal — en machzirin ella echad, veen machzirin lo ella rishon, shenneemar: "hayasgiruni vaale keila veyado hayered shaul vegomer vayyomer Adonai yered". veha amrat en machzirin ella rishon! david shaal
b: Shello kasseder, vehechziru lo kasseder. vechevan sheyyada sheshshaal shello kasseder, chazar veshaal kasseder, shenneemar: "hayasgiru baale keila oti veet anashay beyad shaul vayyomer Adonai yasgiru".

Veim hutzerach haddavar lishnayim — machzirin lo shenayim, shenneemar: "vayyishal david baAdonai lemor haerdof achare haggedud hazze haassigennu vayyomer (Adonai) lo redof ki hasseg tassig vehatztzel tatztzil".
Veaf al pi sheggezerat navi chozeret — gezerat urim vetummim enah chozeret, shenneemar: "bemishpat haurim".
Lamma nikra sheman urim vetummim? "urim" — shemmeirin et divrehen, "tummim" — shemmashlimin et divrehen.
Veim tomar: begivat binyamin mippene ma lo hishlimu?

Hem shello bichanu im lenatztzeach im lehinnatzeach, uvaacharona shebbichanu hiskimu, shenneemar: "ufinchas ben elazar ben aharon omed lefanav bayyamim hahem lemor haosif od latzet lammilchama im bene vinyamin achi im echdal vayyomer Adonai alu ki machar ettenennu veyadecha".
Ketzad naaset? rabbi yochanan omer: boltot. resh lakish omer: mitztarfot.
Veha la ketiv behu tzadi? amar rav shemuel bar yitzchak: "avraham yitzchak veyaakov" ketiv sham. veha la ketiv tet! amar rav acha bar yaakov: "shivte yeshurun" ketiv sham.
Metivi: kol kohen sheeno medabber beruach hakkodesh ushechina shora alav en shoalin bo, shehare shaal tzadok vealta lo, evyatar velo alta lo, shenneemar: "vayyaal evyatar ad tom kol haam vegomer"!
Sayyoe hava mesayyay bahadayyhu.

Veen shoalin ella lemelech. mena hane mille? amar rabbi avahu, deamar kera: "velifne elazar hakkohen yaamod veshaal lo bemishpat haurim vegomer". "hu" — ze melech, "vechol [bene] yisrael itto" — ze meshuach milchama, "vechol haeda" — zo sanhedrin.
Hadaran alach ba lo kohen gadol

Mishna yom hakkippurim asur baachila uvishtiyya uvirchitza uvesicha uvinilat hassandal, uvetashmish hammitta. vehammelech vehakkalla yirchatzu et penehem, vehachayya tinol et hassandal, divre rabbi eliezer. vachachamim osrin.

Haochel kechotevet haggassa, kamoha uchegarinatah, vehashshote melo lugemav — chayyayv. kol haochalim mitztarfin lechakkotevet, vechol hammashkin mitztarfin limlo lugemav. haochel veshote en mitztarfin.
Gemara asur?! anush karet hu! amar rabbi ila, veittema rabbi yirmeya: lo nitzrecha ella lachatzi shiur.
Hanicha leman deamar chatzi shiur asur min hattora, ella leman deamar chatzi shiur muttar min hattora, may ikka lememar?

Deittemar chatzi shiur, rabbi yochanan amar: asur min hattora, resh lakish amar: muttar min hattora. hanicha lerabbi yochanan, ella leresh lakish may ikka lememar? mode resh lakish sheasur midderabbanan.
I hachi, la nichayyayv aleh korban shevua, allema tenan: shevua shello ochal, veachal nevelot uterefot shekatzim uremasim — chayyayv. verabbi shimon poter.
Vehavenan ba: ammay chayyayv? musheba veomed mehar sinay hu? rav ushemuel verabbi yochanan deamri: becholel devarim hammuttarim im devarim haasurin.
Veresh lakish amar: i atta motze ella bimfaresh chatzi shiur, veallibba derabbanan, o bistam,

a: Veallibba derabbi akiva deamar: adam oser atzmo bechol shehu!
Vechi tema: kevan deit leh hetter min hattora, ka chayel korban shevua, vehatnan: shevuat haedut enah noheget ella biruyin lehaid. vehavenan ba: lemaote may? rav pappa amar: lemaote melech.
Rav acha bar yaakov amar: lemaote mesachek bekuveya. veha mesachek bekuveya — middeorayyta michze chaze, verabbanan hu defasluhu, vela ka chayyla aleh shevua!
Shane hatam deamar kera: "im lo yaggid", vehay lav bar haggada hu kelal.

Vechol hecha detane anush karet, la tane asur? vehatanya: af al pi sheamru asur bechullan — lo amru anush karet ella al haochel veshote veose melacha bilvad. hachi kaamar: kesheamru asur — la amru ella bechachatzi shiur, aval keshiur — anush karet. veaf al pi sheanush karet — en anush karet ella ochel veshote veose melacha bilvad.

Vei baet ema: ki katane asur — ashsheara. detanu rabba verav yosef bishar sifre deve rav: minnayin leyom hakkippurim sheasur birchitza besicha uvinilat hassandal uvetashmish hammitta, talmud lomar: "shabbaton" — shevut.

Gufa. chatzi shiur, rabbi yochanan amar: asur min hattora, resh lakish amar: muttar min hattora. rabbi yochanan amar asur min hattora: kevan dachazi leitzterofe, issura ka achel. resh lakish amar muttar min hattora: achila amar rachamana, velekka.

Etiveh rabbi yochanan leresh lakish: en li ella kol sheyyeshno beonesh yeshno beazhara, koy vachatzi shiur, hoil veeno beonesh — yachol eno beazhara, talmud lomar: "kol chelev"! midderabbanan, ukera — asmachta bealma.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach deorayyta, koy sefeka hu, itzterich kera leetoye sefeka? i mishshum ha — la irya, kasavri
b: Koy beriyya bifne atzmah hi. dei la tema hachi, ha deamar rav idi bar avin: af "kol" leetoye koy, koy sefeka hu, itzterich kera lerabboye sefeka? ella beriyya shane, hacha name beriyya shane.
Tanu rabbanan: "teannu et nafshotechem", yachol yeshev bachamma o batztzinna kede sheyyitztaer — talmud lomar: "vechol melacha lo taasu". ma melacha shev veal taase, af innuy nefesh shev veal taase.
Veema: hecha deyatev beshimsha vechayem leh la nema leh kum tuv betulla, yatev betulla vekarer leh la nema leh kum tuv beshimsha! dumeya dimlacha: ma melacha lo chillakta bah, af innuy lo tachlok bo.

Tanya iddach: "teannu et nafshotechem", yachol yeshev bachamma uvatztzinna veyitztaer — talmud lomar: "vechol melacha lo taasu", ma melacha davar shechayyayvin alav bimkom acher, af innuy nefesh shechayyayvin alav bimkom acher, vei ze ze? ze piggul venotar.
Avi piggul venotar shehen becharet, velo avi et hattevel sheeno becharet, talmud lomar: "teannu", "veinnitem et nafshotechem" — ribba.
Avi hattevel shehu bemita velo avi et hannevela sheenah bemita — talmud lomar: "teannu", "veinnitem et nafshotechem" — ribba.
Avi et hannevela shehu belav, velo avi et hachullin sheenan belav? talmud lomar: "teannu", "veinnitem et nafshotechem" — ribba.

Avi hachullin sheenan bekum echol, velo avi et hatteruma shehi bekum echol, talmud lomar: "teannu", "veinnitem et nafshotechem" — ribba. avi et hatteruma sheenah beval totiru, velo avi et hakkodashim shehen beval totiru, talmud lomar: "teannu", "veinnitem et nafshotechem" — ribba.
Veim nafshecha lomar, hare hu omer: "vehaavadti et hannefesh hahi", innuy shehu avedat hannefesh, vee ze ze? ze achila ushetiyya.
May "veim nafshecha lomar"? vechi tema: baarayot ka mishtae kera, — hare hu omer: "vehaavadti hannefesh", innuy sheyyesh bo avedat nefesh, vee ze ze? ze achila ushetiyya.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: neemar kan innuy, veneemar lehallan innuy. ma lehallan innuy reavon, af kan innuy reavon.
Venelaf meim teanne et benotay"? danin innuy derabbim meinnuy derabbim, veen danin innuy derabbim meinnuy deyachid.
Venelaf meinnuy demitzrayim, dichtiv: "vayyar et onyenu", veamrinan: zo perishut derech eretz! ella: danin innuy bide shamayim meinnuy bide shamayim, veen danin innuy bide shamayim meinnuy bide adam.

"Hammaachilcha man bammidbar ... lemaan annotcha"? rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: eno dome mi sheyyesh lo pat besallo lemi sheen lo pat besallo, vechad amar: eno dome mi sheroe veochel lemi sheeno roe veochel.

Amar rav yosef: mikkan remez lesomin, sheochlin veen sevein. amar abbaye: hilkach, man deit leh seodta la lechla ella bimama. amar rabbi zera, may kera: "tov mare enayim mehaloch nafesh". amar resh lakish: tov mare enayim beishsha yoter miggufo shel maase, shenneemar: "tov mare enayim mehaloch nafesh".
"Ki yitten bakkos eno yithallech bemesharim", rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: kol hannoten

a: Eno bechoso, arayot kullan domot alav kemishor. vechad amar: kol hannoten eno bechoso, kol haolam kullo dome alav kemishor.
"Deaga velev ish yashchenna", rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: yassichenna middato, vechad amar: yesichenna laacherim.

"Venachash afar lachmo", rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: afillu ochel kol maadanne olam — toem bahem taam afar, vechad amar: afillu ochel kol maadanne olam — en dato meyushshevet alav ad sheyyochal afar.
