Tanya, amar rabbi yose: bo uree shello kemiddat hakkadosh baruch hu middat basar vadam. middat basar vadam: maknit et chavero — yored immo lechayyav. aval hakkadosh baruch hu eno ken: killel et hannachash, ole laggag — mezonotav immo, yored lematta — mezonotav immo.
Killel et kenaan, ochel ma sherabbo ochel veshote ma sherabbo shote. killel et haishsha — hakkol ratzin achareha. killel et haadama — hakkol nizzonin hemenna.
"Zacharnu et haddaga asher nochal bemitzrayim chinnam", rav ushemuel, chad amar: dagim, vechad amar: arayot. man deamar dagim, dichtiv: "nochal". uman deamar arayot, dichtiv: "chinnam".

Uleman deamar arayot, ha ketiv: "nochal"! lishshana mealleya naket, dichtiv: "achla umachata fiha veamra lo faalti aven". uleman deamar dagim, may "chinnam"? dahavo mayytin lehu mehefkera. deamar mar: keshehayu yisrael shoavin mayim, hakkadosh baruch hu mazmin lahem betoch hammayim dagim ketannim bechaddehen.
Bishlama leman deamar dagim, aval arayot la peritzi behu — hayeynu dichtiv: "gan naul achoti challa [go]". ella leman deamar arayot, may "mayan chatum"? mehanach daasirin la peritzi behu.

Bishlama leman deamar arayot, hayeynu dichtiv: "vayyishma moshe et haam boche lemishpechotav", al iske mishpechotav, shenneesru lahem lishkav etzlam. ella leman deamar dagim, may "boche lemishpechotav"? ha veha havay.

"Et hakkishshuim veet haavattichim", rabbi amme verabbi assi, chad amar: taam kol hamminin taamu bamman, taam chameshet hamminin hallalu lo taamu bo, vechad amar: taam kol hamminin taamu taman umammashan, vehallalu taman velo mammashan.
"(Vehamman) kezera gad lavan (vetamo)". amar rabbi assi: agol kegidda velavan kemargalit. (tanya name hachi:) gad — sheddome lezera pishtan baggivolin.
Acherim omrim: gad — sheddome lehaggada shemmoshechet libbo shel adam kammayim. tanya iddach: gad — shemmaggid lahem leyisrael i ben tisha larishon vei ben shiva laacharon.
"Lavan" — shemmalbin avonotehen shel yisrael.

Tanya, rabbi yose omer: keshem shehannavi haya maggid lahem leyisrael ma shebbechorin uma shebbisdakin, kach hamman maggid lahem leyisrael ma shebbechorin uma shebbisdakin. ketzad? shenayim shebbau lifne moshe ledin, ze omer: avdi ganavta, veze omer: atta mecharto li. amar lahem moshe: labboker mishpat. lemachar, im nimtza omro bevet rabbo rishon — beyadua shezze genavo. im nimtza omro bevet rabbo sheni — beyadua shezze mecharo lo.

Vechen ish veishsha shebbau lifne moshe laddin, ze omer hi sarcha alay, vehi omeret hu sarach alay. amar lahem moshe: labboker mishpat. lemachar, im nimtza omrah bevet balah — beyadua shehi sarcha alav, nimtza omrah bevet aviha — beyadua shehu sarach aleha.

Ketiv: "uveredet hattal al hammachane layla [yered hamman alav]", uchetiv: "veyatza haam velaktu", uchetiv: "shatu haam velaktu", ha ketzad? tzaddikim, yarad al petach battehem. benonim, yatzu velaktu. reshaim, shatu velaktu.
Ketiv "lechem", uchetiv "ugot", uchetiv "vetachanu", ha ketzad? tzaddikim — lechem, benonim — ugot, reshaim — tachanu barechayim.

"O dachu bammedocha", amar rabbi yehuda amar rav, veittema rabbi chama berabbi chanina: melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman tachshite nashim, davar shenniddoch bimdocha. "uvishshelu bapparur", amar rabbi chama: melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman tzike kedera.

"Vehem heviu elav od nedava babboker babboker", may "babboker babboker"? amar rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar rabbi yonatan: middavar sheyyarad lahem "babboker babboker". melammed sheyyardu lahem leyisrael avanim tovot umargaliyyot im hamman. "vehannesiim heviu et avne hashshoham", tana: nesiim mammash. vechen hu omer: "nesiim veruach vegeshem ayin".

"Vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen". amar rabbi avahu: ma shad ze tinok toem bah kamma teamim, af hamman, kol zeman sheyyisrael ochlin oto motzin bo kamma teamim. ikka deamri: leshed mammash. ma shed ze mithappech lechamma gevonin — af hamman mithappech lechamma teamim.
"Vayyomer moshe betet Adonai lachem baerev basar leechol velechem babboker lisboa", tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha: basar sheshshaalu shello kahogen — nittan lahem shello kahogen,
b: Lechem sheshshaalu kahogen — nittan lahem kahogen. mikkan limmeda tora derech eretz shello yochal adam basar ella ballayla. vehaamar abbaye: hay man deit leh seodta — la lechlay ella bimama! keen yemama ka amrinan. amar rav acha bar yaakov: battechilla hayu yisrael domin ketarnegolim shemmenakkerin baashpa, ad shebba moshe vekava lahem zeman seuda.
"Habbasar odennu ben shinnehem", uchetiv: "ad chodesh yamim", ha ketzad? benonim, lealtar metu. reshaim, mitztaarin veholchin ad chodesh yamim.

"Vayyishtechu", amar resh lakish: al tikre "vayyishtechu", ella "vayyishchatu" — melammed shennitchayyeyvu sonehen shel yisrael shechita. "shatoach", tana mishshemeh derabbi yehoshua ben karcha: al tikre "shatoach", ella "shachut", melammed sheyyarad lahem leyisrael im hamman davar shettaun shechita. amar rabbi: vechi mikkan atta lamed? vahalo kevar neemar: "vayyamter alehem keafar sheer uchechol (hayyam) of kanaf".

Vetanya, rabbi omer: "vezavachta kaasher tzivvitich", melammed shennitztavva moshe al havveshet veal hakkane, al rov echad baof, veal rov shenayim babbehema. ella ma talmud lomar "shatoach" — melammed sheyyarad lahem mashtichin mashtichin.
Ketiv "lechem", uchetiv "shemen", uchetiv "devash". amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: linarim — lechem, lizkenim — shemen, letinokot — devash.
Ketiv: "shalev" vekarenan selav? amar rabbi chanina: tzaddikim ochlin oto beshalva, reshaim ochlin oto vedome lahen kesilvin.

Amar rav chanan bar rava: arbaa mine selav hen, veellu hen: shichli, vekivli, ufasyoni, uselav. mealleya dechullehu: sichli, geria dechullehu: selav. vehave ketzippavrta, umotvinan le betannura vetafach vehave mele tannura, umassekinan leh attelesar rife, veacharona enah neechelet ella al yede taarovet.

Rav yehuda mishtechach leh be danne, rav chisda mishtechach leh be tzive. rava mayyte leh ariseh kol yoma. yoma chad la ayyti. amar: may hay? selek leiggara, shameh leyanoka dekaamar: "shamati vattirgaz bitni". amar: shema minneh nach nafsheh derav chisda, uvedil rabba achel talmida.
Ketiv: "vattaal shichvat hattal", uchetiv: "uveredet hattal"? amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: tal milmala, vetal millematta, vedome kemo shemmunnach bekufesa.

"Dak mechusepas", amar resh lakish: davar shennimmoach al pissat hayyad. rabbi yochanan amar: davar shennivla bematayim vearbaim ushemona evarim. mechusepas — tuva have! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: "mechuspas" ketiv.

Tanu rabbanan: "lechem abbirim achal ish", lechem shemmalache hashsharet ochlin oto, divre rabbi akiva. ucheshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yishmael, amar lahem: tzeu veimru lo laakiva: akiva taita! vechi malache hashsharet ochlin lechem? vahalo kevar neemar: "lechem lo achalti umayim lo shatiti"! ella, ma ani mekayyem "abbirim" — lechem shennivla bematayim vearbaim ushemone evarim.
Ella ma ani mekayyem: "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha (veyatzata shamma chutz)", devarim shettaggare ummot haolam mochrin otan lahem.

Rabbi elazar ben parta omer: af devarim shettaggare ummot haolam mochrin lahen — man mefigan. ella ma ani mekayyem "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha" — leachar shessarchu amar hakkadosh baruch hu: ani amarti yihyu kemalache hashsharet, achshav ani matriach otam shalosh parsaot.

Dichtiv: "vayyachanu al hayyarden mibbet hayeshimot ad avel hashshittim", veamar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chaze li hahu atra vehavya telata parse. vetana: keshennifnin, en nifnin lo lifnehen, velo letziddehen, ella laachorehen.
"Veatta nafshenu yevesha en kol". amru: atid man ze shettippach bemeehem, kelum yesh yelud ishsha shemmachnis veeno motzi?

Ucheshennemeru devarim lifne rabbi yishmael, amar lahem: al tikre "abbirim", ella "evarim" — davar shennivla bematayim vearbaim ushemona evarim. ella ma ani mekayyem "veyated tihye lecha al azenecha" — bidvarim shebbain lahem mimmedinat hayyam.
Davar acher: "lechem abbirim achal ish" —

a: Ze yehoshua sheyyarad lo man keneged kol yisrael. ketiv hacha "ish", uchetiv hatam: "kach lecha et yehoshua bin nun ish asher ruach bo". veema moshe, dichtiv: "vehaish moshe anav meod"? danin "ish" meish", veen danin "ish" mivvehaish".

Shaalu talmidav et rabbi shimon ben yochay: mippene ma lo yarad lahem leyisrael man paam achat bashshana? amar lahem: emshol lachem mashal: lema haddavar dome? lemelech basar vadam sheyyesh lo ben echad, pasak lo mezonotav paam achat bashshana, velo haya makbil pene aviv ella paam achat bashshana. amad ufasak mezonotav bechol yom, vehaya makbil pene aviv kol yom.
Af yisrael, mi sheyyesh lo arbaa vachamishsha banim haya doeg veomer: shemma lo yered man lemachar, venimtzeu kullan metim baraav, nimtzeu kullan mechavvevnim et libbam laavihen shebbashshamayim.
Davar acher: shehayu ochlin oto keshehu cham. davar acher: mippene massooy hadderech.

Uchevar haya rabbi tarfon verabbi yishmael uzekenim yoshvin veoskin befarashat hamman, vehaya rabbi elazar hammodai yoshev benehen. naana rabbi elazar hammodai veamar: man sheyyarad lahen leyisrael haya gavoah shishshim amma. amar lo rabbi tarfon: modai, ad matay atta megabbev devarim umevi alenu!

Amar lo: rabbi, mikra ani doresh: "chamesh esre amma milmala gavru hammayim vaychussu heharim", vechi chamesh esre amma baemek, (chamesh esre bashshefela,) chamesh esre beharim? vechi mayya shure shure kayymi. veod: teva hechi saggiya? ella, nivkeu kol mayenot tehom rabba ad deashvo mayya bahade ture, vahadar "chamesh esre amma milmala gavru hammayim".

Vechi e ze midda merubba, midda tova o middat pureanut? heve omer: midda tova mimmiddat pureanut, bemiddat pureanut hu omer: "vaarubbot hashshamayim niftachu". bemidda tova hu omer: "vaytzav shechakim mimmaal vedalte shamayim patach vayyamter alehem man leechol udegan shamayim natan lamo".
Kamma arubbot yesh bedelet — arba arba, hare kan shemone, venimtza man sheyyarad lahem leyisrael gavoah shishshim amma.

Tanya, isi ben yehuda omer: man sheyyarad lahem leyisrael haya mitgabber veole ad sheroin oto kol malche mizrach umaarav, shenneemar: "taaroch lefanay shulchan neged tzorray [vegomer kosi revaya]", amar abbaye: shema minna kasa dedavid lealma deate, matan veesrin vechad lugga machazik, shenneemar: "kosi revaya", revaya begimatriyya hachi have.
Ha la damya. hatam bearbein yomin, hacha chada shata. hatam lechulle alma, hacha leyisrael lechodeh, unefish lehu tefe. rabbi elazar hammodai "peticha" "peticha" gamar.
Asur baachila. hane chamishsha innuyin keneged mi? amar rav chisda: keneged chamishsha innuyin shebbattora: "uveasor", veach beasor", "shabbat shabbaton", veshabbat shabbaton", "vehayta lachem".

Hane chamishsha havu? vaanan shitta tenan! shetiyya bichlal achila hi. deamar resh lakish: minnayin lishtiyya shehi bichlal achila, shenneemar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha", tirosh chamra hu, vekare leh "veachalta".
Mimmay? vedilma deachleh al yede anigron! deamar rabba bar shemuel: anigron mayya desilka, akkesigron mayya dechullehu shilke.
Ella amar rav acha bar yaakov, mehacha: "venatatta hakkesef bechol asher teavve nafshecha babbakar uvatztzon beyayin uvashshechar". shechar shetiyya hu, vekaryeh rachamana "veachalta".
Mimmay? vedilma hacha name deachleh al yede anigron! "shechar" ketiv, midde dimshakkar. vedilma devela keilit? detanya: achal devela keilit veshata devash vechalav venichnas lammikdash —
b: (Chayyayv).
Ella: yalef "shechar" "shechar" minnazir, ma lehallan — yayin, af kan yayin.
Vetirosh chamra hu? vehatanya: hannoder min hattirosh — asur bechol mine metika umuttar beyayin! velav chamra hu? vehachtiv: "vetirosh yenovev betulot", davar habba min hattirosh — yenovev betulot.
Vehachtiv: "vetirosh yekavecha yifrotzu"! davar habba min hattirosh — yekavecha yifrotzu.
Veha ketiv "zenut veyayin vetirosh yikkach lev"! ella, dechulle alma tirosh chamra hu, uvindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam.
Veammay kare leh yayin, veammay kare leh tirosh? yayin — shemmevi yelala leolam. tirosh — shekkol hammitgare bo naasa rash.

Rav kahana rame: ketiv "tirash", vekarenan "tirosh". zacha — naasa rosh, lo zacha — naasa rash. (vehayeynu derava derava) rame, ketiv: "yeshammach", vekarenan yesammach. zacha — mesammecho, lo zacha — meshammemo. vehayeynu deamar rava: chamra verechane — pakchuyn.

Rechitza vesicha, mena lan deikkeri innuy. dichtiv: "lechem chamudot lo achalti uvasar vayayin lo va el pi vesoch lo sachti". may "lechem chamudot lo achalti"? amar rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat: afillu nahama dechitte dachyayta, la achal.

Umena lan dachashiv keinnuy — dichtiv: "vayyomer elay al tira daniyyel ki min hayyom harishon asher natatta et libbecha lehavin ulehitannot lifne elohecha nishmeu devarecha vaani vati bidvarecha". ("ki chamudot atta".)

Ashkechan sicha, rechitza mena lan? amar rav zutera berabbi toviyya, amar kera: "vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav". veema kishtiyya! dumeya deshemen: ma shemen meabbaray, af mayim meabbaray.

Veha tanna ippecha ka nasev la, ditnan: minnayin lesicha shehi kishtiyya beyom hakkippurim? af al pi sheen reaya laddavar, zecher laddavar, shenneemar: "vattavo chammayim bekirbo vechashshemen beatzmotav"! ella amar rav ashe: rechitza miggufeh dikra shemia leh, dichtiv: "vesoch lo sachti".

May: "vaani bati bidvarecha"? hayeynu dichtiv: "veshivim ish mizzikne [vet] yisrael veyaazanyahu ven shafan omed betocham omdim lifnehem veish miktarto beyado vaatar anan hakketoret ole". "vayyishlach tavnit yad vayyikkacheni betzitzit roshi vattissa oti ruach ben haaretz uven hashshamayim vattave oti yerushalayma bemarot elohim el petach shaar happenimit happone tzafona asher

a: Sham moshav semel hakkina hammakne", "vayyave oti el chatzar bet Adonai happenimit vehinne fetach hechal Adonai ben haulam uven hammizbeach keesrim vachamishsha ish achorehem el hechal Adonai ufenehem kedma vehemma mishtachavim kedma lashshamesh". mimmashma shenneemar "ufenehem kedma", eni yodea sheachorehem el hechal Adonai? ella, ma talmud lomar "achorehem el hechal Adonai — melammed shehayu porin atzman vehayu matrizin kelappe matta.

Amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lemichael: michael! sarcha ummatecha. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, dayyi lattovim shebbahem! amar lo: ani soref otam velattovim shebbahem, miyyad: "vayyomer (laish) levush habbaddim vayyomer bo el benot laggalgal el tachat lakkeruv umalle chofnecha gachale esh mibbenot lakkeruvim uzerok al hair vayyavo leenay". miyyad: "vayyishlach hakkeruv et yado mibbenot lakkeruvim el haesh asher benot hakkeruvim vayyissa vayyitten el chofne levush habbaddim vayyikkach vayyetze".
Amar rav chana bar bizna amar rabbi shimon chasida: ilmale lo nitztannenu gechalim miyyado shel keruv leyado shel gavriel — lo nishtayyeyru missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit.

Uchetiv: "vehinne haish levush habbaddim asher hakkeset bemotnav meshiv davar lemor asiti kaasher tzivvitani". amar rabbi yochanan: beotah shaa hotziu legavriel meachore happargod, umachyuhu shittin pulese denura. amaru leh: i la avadt — la avadt, i avadt — ammay la avadt kidfakkeduch? veod: daavadt, let lach en meshivin al hakkalkala?

Ayytu ledubbiel sara defarsae veokmu bacharikeh, veshammesh esrim veechad yom. hayeynu dichtiv: "vesar malchut paras omed lenegdi esrim veechad yom vehinne michael achad hassarim harishonim ba leozreni vaani notarti sham etzel malche faras", yehavu leh esrin vechad malche ufarvota demashhig.

Amar: ketivu li leyisrael beakkeraga. ketavu leh. ketivu li rabbanan beakkeraga. ketavu leh. beiddana devau lemichtam, amad gavriel meachore happargod veamar: "shav lachem mashkime kum meachare shevet ochle lechem haatzavim ken yitten lidido shena", may "ken yitten lidido shena"? amar rabbi yitzchak: ellu neshotehen shel talmide chachamim shemmenaddedot shena baolam hazze vezochot laolam habba, velo hishgichu alav.

Amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam! im yihyu kol chachme ummot haolam bechaf moznayim, vedaniyyel ish chamudot bechaf sheniyya, lo nimtza machria et kullam?! amar hakkadosh baruch hu: mi hu ze shemmelammed zechut al banay? amru lefanav: ribbono shel olam, gavriel. amar lahem: yavo. shenneemar: "vaani vati bidvarecha". amar lehu: leul. aayyluhu.

Ata, ashkecheh ledubbiel denaket leh leiggarteh bideh, bea lemirma minneh, bala. ikka deamri: michtav hava ketiva, michtam la hava chatima. ikka deamri: af michtam name hava chatima, kidvala, mechek la minneh. hayeynu divmalchuta defaras, ikka deyahev keraga veikka dela yahev keraga: "vaani yotze vehinne sar yavan ba", avvi avvi velekka deashgach beh.

Vei baet ema: rechitza deikkeri innuy mena lan — mehacha, dichtiv: "uleevyatar hakkohen amar hammelech anatot lech al sadcha ki ish mavet atta uvayyom hazze lo amitecha ki nasata [et] aron Adonai lifne david avi vechi hitannita bechol asher hitanna avi". uchetiv beh bedavid: "ki amru haam raev veayef vetzame bammidbar". raev millechem, vetzame mimmayim, ayef mimmay — lav merchitza? vedilma minneilat hassandal?
Ella amar rabbi yitzchak, mehacha: "mayim karim al nefesh ayefa". vedilma mishshetiyya? mi ketiv "benefesh ayefa"? "al nefesh ayefa" ketiv.
Uneilat hassandal mena lan? dichtiv: "vedavid ole vemaale hazzetim ole uvoche verosh lo chafuy (veholech) yachef", yachef mimmay — lav minneilat hassandal? vedilma missuseya umarteka.

Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, mehacha: "lech ufittachta hassak meal motnecha venaalcha tachalotz meal raglecha", uchetiv: "vayyaas ken haloch arom veyachef". yachef mimmay — lav minneilat hassandal? veema beminalim hametullaim? dei la tema hachi, "arom" — arom mammash, ella bivgadim beluyim, hacha name beminalim hametullaim.

Ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, mehacha: "mini raglech miyyachef ugeronech mitztzima", mini atzmecha min hachet kede shello yavo raglecha lide yichuf, mini leshonech middevarim betelim kede shello yavo geronech lide tzima.
Tashmish hammitta deikkeri innuy mena lan? dichtiv: "im teanne et benotay veim tikkach nashim".
b: "Im teanne" — mittashmish, "veim tikkach" — mitztzarot. veema idde veidde mitztzarot? mi ketiv "im tikkach"? "veim tikkach" ketiv.
Veema idde veidde mitztzarot, chad letzarot dideh, vechad letzarot deatyayn leh mealma, dumeya deim tikkach"! mi ketiv "im tikkach veim teanne"? "im teanne veim tikkach" ketiv.
Amar leh rav pappa leabbaye: ha tashmish gufe ikkeri innuy, dichtiv: "vayyishkav otah vayanneha"! amar leh: hatam sheinnah mibbiot acherot.

Tanu rabbanan: asur lirchotz miktzat gufo kechol gufo, veim haya meluchelach betit uvetzoa — rochetz kedarko veeno choshesh. asur lasuch miktzat gufo kechol gufo, veim haya chole, o shehayu lo chatatin berosho — sach kedarko veeno choshesh.
Tena deve menashshe: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: medicha ishsha yadah achat bemayim, venotenet pat lattinok, veenah chosheshet.
Amru alav al shammay hazzaken shello ratza lehaachil beyado achat, vegazru alav lehaachil bishte yadayim. may tama? amar abbaye: mishshum shivta.
Tanu rabbanan: haholech lehakebil pene aviv o pene rabbo, o pene mi sheggadol mimmennu — over ad tzavvaro bemayim veeno choshesh.

Ibbaya lehu: harav etzel talmid may? ta shema, deamar rav yitzchak bar bar chana: ana chazeteh lizeri daazal legabbe rav chiyyay bar ashe talmideh. rav ashe amar: hahu rav chiyyay bar ashe hu daazal legabbeh dizeri rabbeh.
Rava shera livne avar yammina lemebar bemayya lenattore pere. amar leh abbaye lerava, tanya dimsayyay lach: shomre perot ovrin ad tzavvaran bemayim veen choshshin.

Rav yosef shera lehu livne be tarbu lemibar bemayya lemete lefirka, lemezal la shera lehu. amar leh abbaye: im ken atta machshilan leatid lavo. ikka deamri: shera lehu lemete ushera lehu lemezal, amar leh abbaye: bishlama lemete — lechayye, ella lemezal may tama? kede shello tehe machshilan leatid lavo.

Rav yehuda verav shemuel bar rav yehuda havo kayymi aggudda dinhar (pappa) ammabbara dechatzdad, vahava kae rame bar pappa mehach gisa. rema lehu kala: mahu lemibar lemete legabbayychu lemishal shemata? amar leh rav yehuda: rav ushemuel deamri tarvayyhu — over, uvilvad shello yotzi yado mittachat chefet chaluko. ikka deamri, amar leh rav shemuel bar rav yehuda, tenena: over, uvilvad shello yotzi yado mittachat chefet chaluko.
Matkef la rav yosef: uvechol ki hay gavna mi shere? vehachtiv: "vayyamod elef baamma vayyaavireni vammayim me ofsayim" — mikkan shemmuttar laavor ad ofsayim.

"Vayyamod elef vayyaavireni vammayim mayim birkayim" — mikkan shemmuttar laavor ad birkayim. "vayyamod elef vayyaavireni me motnayim" — mikkan shemmuttar laavor ad motnayim. mikkan veelach: "vayyamod elef nachal asher lo uchal laavor"!
Amar abbaye: shane nachal dirdifi mayya.

Yachol yaavirennu besichuy — talmud lomar: "ki gau hammayim me sachu". may "me sachu" — shiyyuta, shekken korin leshayyayta sayyaycha. yachol yaavirennu bevureni ketanna — talmud lomar: "bal telech bo oni shayit". yachol yaavirennu bevureni gedola — talmud lomar: "vetzi addir lo yaavrennu". may mashma? kedimtargem rav yosef: la tezil beh bisfinat tzayyaydin uvureni rabbeti lo teguzinne.
Amar rabbi yehuda ben pazzi: af malach hammavet en lo reshut laavor betocho, ketiv hacha: "bal telech bo oni shayit", uchetiv hatam: "mishshut baaretz".

Amar rabbi pinchas mishshum rav huna tzipporaa: mayan hayyotze mibbet kodshe hakkodashim, battechilla dome lekarne chagavim, kevan shehiggia lefetach hechol — naase kechut shel sheti, kevan shehiggia laulam — naase kechut shel erev, kevan shehiggia el petach azara — naase kefi pach katan, vehayeynu ditnan, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: mayim
